Homage to the Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Fully Awakened Buddha ^T-1

# In the Abhidhamma Piṭaka ^0

## The Book of Conditional Relations ^7-0

### (Part One) ^7-1-0

#### The Positive Method by States ^7-1-1-0

##### Conditional Relations of the Triads ^7-1-1-1-0

###### (1) Outline of the Conditions ^7-1-1-1-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-U1]]

The root condition, the object condition, the predominance condition, the proximity condition, the contiguity condition, the co-arising condition, the mutuality condition, the support condition, the strong-support condition, the pre-arising condition, the post-arising condition, the repetition condition, the kamma condition, the result condition, the nutriment condition, the faculty condition, the jhāna condition, the path condition, the association condition, the dissociation condition, the presence condition, the absence condition, the disappearance condition and the non-disappearance condition. ^7-U1

###### (2) Explanation of the Conditions ^7-1-1-1-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-1]]

The root condition – roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the states associated with the roots and for the matter produced by them [variant: paccayoti (Syā.)]. ^7-1-1

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-2]]

The object condition – the visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The sound base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The odour base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The taste base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The visible-form base, the sound base, the odour base, the taste base and the tangible base are a condition, by way of object condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. All states are a condition, by way of object condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
Whatever states arise – consciousness and mental factors – taking some state as their object, that state is a condition for them by way of object condition. ^7-1-2

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-3]]

The predominance condition – predominant desire is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the states associated with desire and for the matter produced by them. Predominant energy is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the states associated with energy and for the matter produced by them. Predominant consciousness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the states associated with consciousness and for the matter produced by them. Predominant investigation is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the states associated with investigation and for the matter produced by them.
Whatever states arise – consciousness and mental factors – giving weight to some state, that state is a condition for them by way of predominance condition. ^7-1-3

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-4]]

The proximity condition – the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The body-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
Preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following wholesome states. Preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following neutral states.
Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following unwholesome states. Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following neutral states.
Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following neutral states. Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following wholesome states. Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following unwholesome states.
Whatever states arise – consciousness and mental factors – immediately after whatever states, those earlier states are a condition for them by way of proximity condition. ^7-1-4

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-5]]

The contiguity condition – the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The body-consciousness element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. The mind element and the states associated with it are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
Preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for following wholesome states. Preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for following neutral states.
Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for following unwholesome states. Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for following neutral states.
Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for following neutral states. Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for following wholesome states. Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of contiguity condition, for following unwholesome states.
Whatever states arise – consciousness and mental factors – right after whatever states, those earlier states are a condition for them by way of contiguity condition. ^7-1-5

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-6]]

The co-arising condition – the four immaterial aggregates are a condition for one another by way of co-arising condition. The four great elements are a condition for one another by way of co-arising condition. At the moment of conception, mind and matter are a condition for one another by way of co-arising condition. Consciousness and mental factors are a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for matter produced by consciousness. The great elements are a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for derived matter. Material states are sometimes [variant: kañci kālaṃ (Syā.)] a condition for immaterial states by way of co-arising condition, and at other times are not a condition for them by way of co-arising condition. ^7-1-6

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-7]]

The mutuality condition – the four immaterial aggregates are a condition for one another by way of mutuality condition. The four great elements are a condition for one another by way of mutuality condition. At the moment of conception, mind and matter are a condition for one another by way of mutuality condition. ^7-1-7

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-8]]

The support condition – the four immaterial aggregates are a condition for one another by way of support condition. The four great elements are a condition for one another by way of support condition. At the moment of conception, mind and matter are a condition for one another by way of support condition. Consciousness and mental factors are a condition, by way of support condition, for matter produced by consciousness. The great elements are a condition, by way of support condition, for derived matter.
The eye base is a condition, by way of support condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The ear base is a condition, by way of support condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The nose base is a condition, by way of support condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tongue base is a condition, by way of support condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The body base is a condition, by way of support condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The matter in dependence on which the mind element and the mind-consciousness element occur is a condition, by way of support condition, for the mind element, the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with them. ^7-1-8

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-9]]

The strong-support condition – preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following wholesome states. Preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for some following unwholesome states. Preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following neutral states.
Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following unwholesome states. Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for some following wholesome states. Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following neutral states.
Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following neutral states. Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following wholesome states. Preceding neutral states are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following unwholesome states.
Climate and food too are a condition by way of strong-support condition. A person too is a condition by way of strong-support condition. Lodging too is a condition by way of strong-support condition. ^7-1-9

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-10]]

The pre-arising condition – the eye base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The ear base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The nose base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tongue base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The body base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The visible-form base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The sound base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The odour base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The taste base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The visible-form base, the sound base, the odour base, the taste base and the tangible base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it.
The matter in dependence on which the mind element and the mind-consciousness element occur is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it. For the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with it, it is sometimes a condition by way of pre-arising condition, and at other times is not a condition by way of pre-arising condition. ^7-1-10

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-11]]

The post-arising condition – consciousness and mental factors that arise later are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this body that arose earlier. ^7-1-11

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-12]]

The repetition condition – preceding wholesome states are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following wholesome states. Preceding unwholesome states are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following unwholesome states. Preceding functional neutral states are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following functional neutral states. ^7-1-12

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-13]]

The kamma condition – wholesome and unwholesome kamma is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. Volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the states associated with it and for the matter produced by them. ^7-1-13

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-14]]

The result condition – the four immaterial resultant aggregates are a condition for one another by way of result condition. ^7-1-14

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-15]]

The nutriment condition – physical food [variant: kabaḷiṅkāro (Ka., Sī., Syā.)] is a condition, by way of nutriment condition, for this body. The immaterial nutriments are a condition, by way of nutriment condition, for the states associated with them and for the matter produced by them. ^7-1-15

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-16]]

The faculty condition – the eye faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The ear faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The nose faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tongue faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The body faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The material life faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for matter produced by kamma.
The immaterial faculties are a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the states associated with them and for the matter produced by them. ^7-1-16

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-17]]

The jhāna condition – the jhāna factors are a condition, by way of jhāna condition, for the states associated with jhāna and for the matter produced by them. ^7-1-17

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-18]]

The path condition – the path factors are a condition, by way of path condition, for the states associated with the path and for the matter produced by them. ^7-1-18

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-19]]

The association condition – the four immaterial aggregates are a condition for one another by way of association condition. ^7-1-19

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-20]]

The dissociation condition – material states are a condition for immaterial states by way of dissociation condition. Immaterial states are a condition for material states by way of dissociation condition. ^7-1-20

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-21]]

The presence condition – the four immaterial aggregates are a condition for one another by way of presence condition. The four great elements are a condition for one another by way of presence condition. At the moment of conception, mind and matter are a condition for one another by way of presence condition. Consciousness and mental factors are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by consciousness. The great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for derived matter.
The eye base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The ear base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The nose base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tongue base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The body base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The visible-form base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The sound base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The odour base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The taste base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tangible base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The visible-form base, the sound base, the odour base, the taste base and the tangible base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it.
The matter in dependence on which the mind element and the mind-consciousness element occur is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the mind element, the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with them. ^7-1-21

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-22]]

The absence condition – consciousness and mental factors that have just ceased are a condition, by way of absence condition, for consciousness and mental factors that are present now. ^7-1-22

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-23]]

The disappearance condition – consciousness and mental factors that have just disappeared are a condition, by way of disappearance condition, for consciousness and mental factors that are present now. ^7-1-23

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-1-24]]

The non-disappearance condition – the four immaterial aggregates are a condition for one another by way of non-disappearance condition. The four great elements are a condition for one another by way of non-disappearance condition. At the moment of conception, mind and matter are a condition for one another by way of non-disappearance condition. Consciousness and mental factors are a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. The great elements are a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for derived matter.

The nose base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tongue base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The body base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it.
The visible-form base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the eye-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The sound base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the ear-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The odour base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the nose-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The taste base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the tongue-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The tangible base is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the body-consciousness element and the states associated with it. The visible-form base, the sound base, the odour base, the taste base and the tangible base are a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the mind element and the states associated with it.
The matter in dependence on which the mind element and the mind-consciousness element occur is a condition, by way of non-disappearance condition, for the mind element, the mind-consciousness element and the states associated with them.
The explanation of the conditions. ^7-1-24

With a wholesome state as condition, a wholesome state arises not because of the result condition – with one wholesome aggregate as condition… three.
With an unwholesome state as condition… three.
With a neutral state as condition, a neutral state arises not because of the result condition – with one functional neutral aggregate as condition, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… with two aggregates as condition, two aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; with one great element as condition, three great elements… with the great elements as condition, matter produced by consciousness and derived matter; external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, with one great element as condition, three great elements… with the great elements as condition, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; with the physical base as condition, the functional neutral aggregates.
With a neutral state as condition, a wholesome state arises not because of the result condition – with the physical base as condition, the wholesome aggregates.
(Leaving out the resultant, it should be expanded in every case.) ^7-2-283

######## *The Not-Nutriment Condition and the Rest* ^7-1-1-1-4-17-9-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-284]]

With a neutral state as condition, a neutral state arises not because of the nutriment condition… not because of the faculty condition… not because of the jhāna condition… with the eye base as condition, eye-consciousness… with the body base as condition, body-consciousness. (Under not-jhāna, this is the difference.) Not because of the path condition… with the eye base as condition, eye-consciousness… with the body base as condition, body-consciousness. With the physical base as condition, the resultant neutral and functional neutral aggregates without roots. (Under not-path, this is the difference.)
(The rest should be expanded in the same way as the negative method in the dependence section.) ^7-2-284

######## *The Not-Association Condition and the Rest* ^7-1-1-1-4-17-10-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-285]]

Not because of the association condition… not because of the dissociation condition… not because of the absence condition… with a wholesome state as condition, a neutral state arises not because of the disappearance condition – with the wholesome aggregates as condition, matter produced by consciousness.
(It should be expanded in the same way as in the dependence section.) ^7-2-285

####### *The Exposition* ^7-1-1-1-4-23-0

######## *The Root Condition* ^7-1-1-1-4-23-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-329]]

Supported by a wholesome state, a wholesome state arises because of the root condition – supported by one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates; supported by three aggregates, one aggregate; supported by two aggregates, two aggregates. Supported by a wholesome state, a neutral state arises because of the root condition – supported by the wholesome aggregates, matter produced by consciousness. Supported by a wholesome state, wholesome and neutral states arise because of the root condition. Supported by one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; supported by three aggregates, one aggregate and matter produced by consciousness; supported by two aggregates, two aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-2-329

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-330]]

Supported by an unwholesome state, an unwholesome state arises because of the root condition – supported by one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates… supported by two aggregates, two aggregates. Supported by an unwholesome state, a neutral state arises because of the root condition – supported by the unwholesome aggregates, matter produced by consciousness. Supported by an unwholesome state, unwholesome and neutral states arise because of the root condition – supported by one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… supported by two aggregates, two aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-2-330

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-331]]

Supported by a neutral state, a neutral state arises because of the root condition – supported by one resultant neutral or functional neutral aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; supported by three aggregates, one aggregate and matter produced by consciousness; supported by two aggregates, two aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, supported by one resultant neutral aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by kamma; supported by three aggregates, one aggregate and matter produced by kamma; supported by two aggregates, two aggregates and matter produced by kamma; supported by the aggregates, the physical base; supported by the physical base, the aggregates; supported by one great element, three great elements; supported by three great elements, one great element; supported by two great elements, two great elements; supported by the great elements, matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; supported by the physical base, the resultant neutral and functional neutral aggregates. (1)
Supported by a neutral state, a wholesome state arises because of the root condition – supported by the physical base, the wholesome aggregates. (2)
Supported by a neutral state, an unwholesome state arises because of the root condition – supported by the physical base, the unwholesome aggregates. (3)
Supported by a neutral state, wholesome and neutral states arise because of the root condition – supported by the physical base, the wholesome aggregates; supported by the great elements, matter produced by consciousness. (4)
Supported by a neutral state, unwholesome and neutral states arise because of the root condition – supported by the physical base, the unwholesome aggregates; supported by the great elements, matter produced by consciousness. (5) ^7-2-331

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-332]]

Supported by a wholesome and a neutral state, a wholesome state arises because of the root condition – supported by one wholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates… supported by two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates. Supported by a wholesome and a neutral state, a neutral state arises because of the root condition – supported by the wholesome aggregates and the great elements, matter produced by consciousness. Supported by a wholesome and a neutral state, wholesome and neutral states arise because of the root condition – supported by one wholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates… supported by two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates; supported by the wholesome aggregates and the great elements, matter produced by consciousness. (3)
Supported by an unwholesome and a neutral state, an unwholesome state arises because of the root condition – supported by one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates… supported by two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates. Supported by an unwholesome and a neutral state, a neutral state arises because of the root condition – supported by the unwholesome aggregates and the great elements, matter produced by consciousness. Supported by an unwholesome and a neutral state, unwholesome and neutral states arise because of the root condition – supported by one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates… supported by two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates; supported by the unwholesome aggregates and the great elements, matter produced by consciousness. (3)
(It should be expanded as in the Condition Section.) ^7-2-332

######## *The Root Condition* ^7-1-1-1-4-42-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-392]]

Associated with a wholesome state, a wholesome state arises because of the root condition – associated with one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates; associated with three aggregates, one aggregate; associated with two aggregates, two aggregates. (1) ^7-2-392

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-393]]

Associated with an unwholesome state, an unwholesome state arises because of the root condition – associated with one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates; associated with three aggregates, one aggregate; associated with two aggregates, two aggregates. (1) ^7-2-393

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-394]]

Associated with a neutral state, a neutral state arises because of the root condition – associated with one resultant neutral or functional neutral aggregate, three aggregates; associated with three aggregates, one aggregate; associated with two aggregates, two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth, associated with one resultant neutral aggregate, three aggregates; associated with three aggregates, one aggregate; associated with two aggregates, two aggregates. (Abbreviated.) (1) ^7-2-394

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-397]]

Associated with a neutral state, a neutral state arises not because of the root condition – associated with one resultant neutral or functional neutral aggregate without roots, three aggregates; associated with three aggregates, one aggregate; associated with two aggregates, two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth without roots, associated with one resultant neutral aggregate, three aggregates; associated with three aggregates, one aggregate; associated with two aggregates, two aggregates. ######## *The Object Condition* ^7-1-1-1-4-52-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-404]]

A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; trainees review change-of-lineage, they review cleansing; trainees, having emerged from the path, review the path; trainees or ordinary people see the wholesome with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses wholesome consciousness. The wholesome state of the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the wholesome state of the base of infinite consciousness. The wholesome state of the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the wholesome state of the base of neither perception nor non-perception. Wholesome aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and knowledge of the future. (1) ^7-2-404

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-405]]

A wholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, distress arises. One enjoys and delights in good deeds done in the past; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, distress arises. Having emerged from jhāna, one enjoys and delights in the jhāna; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises. When the jhāna has been lost, distress arises in one who feels remorse. (2) ^7-2-405

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-406]]

A wholesome state is a condition for a neutral state by way of object condition – an arahant, having emerged from the path, reviews the path; reviews good deeds done in the past; sees the wholesome with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; by knowledge of others' minds knows the consciousness of one who possesses wholesome consciousness. Trainees or ordinary people see the wholesome with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; when the wholesome has ceased, a result arises as registration. One enjoys and delights in the wholesome; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, distress arises; when the unwholesome has ceased, a result arises as registration. The wholesome state of the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the resultant and the functional states of the base of infinite consciousness. The wholesome state of the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the resultant and the functional states of the base of neither perception nor non-perception. Wholesome aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. Two aggregates are a condition, by way of support condition, for two aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. The aggregates are a condition, by way of support condition, for the physical base. The great elements are a condition, by way of support condition, for matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition, by way of support condition, for three great elements. Three great elements are a condition, by way of support condition, for one great element. Two great elements are a condition, by way of support condition, for two great elements. The great elements are a condition, by way of support condition, for matter produced by kamma and derived matter. The eye base is a condition, by way of support condition, for eye-consciousness. A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support.
Object strong-support – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, giving it weight; one reviews good deeds done in the past, giving them weight; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, giving it weight; trainees review change-of-lineage, giving it weight; they review cleansing, giving it weight; trainees, having emerged from the path, review the path, giving it weight.
Proximity strong-support – preceding wholesome aggregates are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following wholesome aggregates. Conformity for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the path.
Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna, produces insight, produces the path, produces higher knowledge, produces an attainment. Relying on virtue… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna, produces insight, produces the path, produces higher knowledge, produces an attainment. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom.
The preliminary work for the first jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the first jhāna. The preliminary work for the second jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the second jhāna. The preliminary work for the third jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the third jhāna. The preliminary work for the fourth jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the fourth jhāna. The preliminary work for the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of infinite space. The preliminary work for the base of infinite consciousness is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The preliminary work for the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of nothingness. The preliminary work for the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The first jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the second jhāna. The second jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the third jhāna. The third jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the fourth jhāna. The fourth jhāna is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of infinite space. The base of infinite space is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of infinite consciousness is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of nothingness. The base of nothingness is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The preliminary work for the divine eye is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the divine eye. The preliminary work for the divine ear element is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the divine ear element. The preliminary work for knowledge of supernormal powers is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers. The preliminary work for knowledge of others' minds is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of others' minds. The preliminary work for knowledge of recollecting past lives is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of recollecting past lives. The preliminary work for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma. The preliminary work for knowledge of the future is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of the future. The divine eye is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the divine ear element. The divine ear element is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers. Knowledge of supernormal powers is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of others' minds. Knowledge of others' minds is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of recollecting past lives. Knowledge of recollecting past lives is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma. Knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for knowledge of the future. The preliminary work for the first path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the first path. The preliminary work for the second path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the second path. The preliminary work for the third path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the third path. The preliminary work for the fourth path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the fourth path. The first path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the second path. The second path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the third path. The third path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the fourth path. Relying on the path, trainees produce an attainment that has not yet arisen, enter one that has arisen, and see formations with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. The path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for trainees' analytical knowledge of meaning, analytical knowledge of teachings, analytical knowledge of language, analytical knowledge of ready expression, and for skill in what is possible and what is impossible. (1)
A wholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support.
Object strong-support – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one enjoys and delights in it, giving it weight; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. One enjoys and delights in good deeds done in the past, giving them weight; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Having emerged from jhāna, one enjoys and delights in the jhāna, giving it weight; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises.
Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on virtue… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom, one fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for lust… for hatred… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing. (2)
A wholesome state is a condition for a neutral state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support.
Object strong-support – an arahant, having emerged from the path, reviews the path, giving it weight.
Proximity strong-support – the wholesome for emergence… the path for fruit… conformity for a trainee's attainment of fruition… for one emerging from cessation, the wholesome state of the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the attainment of fruition.
Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one torments and afflicts oneself, and undergoes suffering rooted in seeking. Relying on virtue… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom, one torments and afflicts oneself, and undergoes suffering rooted in seeking. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain… for the attainment of fruition. Wholesome kamma is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for its result. Relying on the path, an arahant produces a functional attainment that has not yet arisen, enters one that has arisen, and sees formations with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. The path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for an arahant's analytical knowledge of meaning, analytical knowledge of teachings, analytical knowledge of language, analytical knowledge of ready expression, and for skill in what is possible and what is impossible. The path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the attainment of fruition. (3)
An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support.
Object strong-support – one enjoys and delights in lust, giving it weight; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. One enjoys and delights in wrong view, giving it weight; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises.
Proximity strong-support – preceding unwholesome aggregates are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following unwholesome aggregates.
Natural strong-support – relying on lust, one kills a living being, takes what is not given, tells lies, speaks divisively, speaks harshly, chatters idly, breaks into houses, carries off plunder, robs a single house, lies in ambush on the road, goes to another's wife, raids a village, raids a town, takes the life of one's mother, takes the life of one's father, takes the life of an arahant, with a malicious mind draws the Buddha's blood, causes a split in the monastic community. Relying on hatred… relying on delusion… relying on conceit… relying on wrong view… relying on longing, one kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community. Lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for lust… for hatred… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing. Killing living beings is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for killing living beings. Killing living beings is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for taking what is not given… for sexual misconduct… for false speech… for divisive speech… for harsh speech… for idle chatter… for covetousness… for ill will… for wrong view. Taking what is not given is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for taking what is not given… for sexual misconduct… for false speech… (abbreviated) for wrong view… for killing living beings. (The cycle should be linked together.) Sexual misconduct… false speech… divisive speech… harsh speech… idle chatter… covetousness… ill will… wrong view is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for wrong view. Wrong view is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for killing living beings… for taking what is not given… for sexual misconduct… for false speech… for divisive speech… for harsh speech… for idle chatter… for covetousness… for ill will. The act of killing one's mother is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's mother. The act of killing one's mother is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's father… for the act of killing an arahant… for the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… for the act of splitting the monastic community… for fixed wrong view. The act of killing one's father is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's father… for the act of killing an arahant… for the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… for the act of splitting the monastic community… for fixed wrong view… for the act of killing one's mother. The act of killing an arahant is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing an arahant… for the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… the act of drawing the Buddha's blood for the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… the act of splitting the monastic community for the act of splitting the monastic community… fixed wrong view is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for fixed wrong view. Fixed wrong view is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's mother… for the act of killing an arahant… for the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… for the act of splitting the monastic community. (The cycle should be worked out.) (1)
An unwholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of strong-support condition. Natural strong-support – relying on lust, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna, produces insight, produces the path, produces higher knowledge, produces an attainment. Relying on hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna, produces insight, produces the path, produces higher knowledge, produces an attainment. Lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom. Having killed a living being, in order to counteract it one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna, produces insight, produces the path, produces higher knowledge, produces an attainment. Having taken what is not given… having told lies… having spoken divisively… having spoken harshly… having chattered idly… having broken into a house… having carried off plunder… having robbed a single house… having lain in ambush on the road… having gone to another's wife… having raided a village… having raided a town, in order to counteract it one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna, produces insight, produces the path, produces higher knowledge, produces an attainment. Having taken the life of one's mother, in order to counteract it one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. Having taken the life of one's father… having taken the life of an arahant… having drawn the Buddha's blood with a malicious mind… having caused a split in the monastic community, in order to counteract it one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. An unwholesome state is a condition for a neutral state by way of strong-support condition – proximity strong-support, natural strong-support.
Proximity strong-support – the unwholesome is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for emergence.

Lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain… for the attainment of fruition. Unwholesome kamma is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for its result. (3)
A neutral state is a condition for a neutral state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support.

Proximity strong-support – preceding resultant neutral and functional neutral aggregates are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for following resultant neutral and functional neutral aggregates. Natural strong-support – bodily pleasure is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain and for the attainment of fruition. Food is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain and for the attainment of fruition. ######## *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-1-1-1-4-52-11-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-2-424]]

A neutral state is a condition for a neutral state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base.
Pre-arising object – an arahant sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for eye-consciousness. The sound base for ear-consciousness… the odour base for nose-consciousness… the taste base for tongue-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for body-consciousness.
Pre-arising physical base – the eye base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for eye-consciousness. The ear base for ear-consciousness… the nose base for nose-consciousness… the tongue base for tongue-consciousness… the body base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for body-consciousness. The physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for resultant neutral and functional neutral aggregates. (1)
A neutral state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base.
Pre-arising object – trainees or ordinary people see the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… they see the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. They see a visible form with the divine eye. They hear a sound with the divine ear element.
Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for wholesome aggregates. (2)
A neutral state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – one enjoys and delights in the eye; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, distress arises. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… one enjoys and delights in the physical base; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises.
Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for unwholesome aggregates. (3) ^7-2-424

###### The Feeling Triad ^7-1-1-1-5-0

####### *The Dependence Section* ^7-1-1-1-5-1-0

######## *The Exposition* ^7-1-1-1-5-2-1-0

######## *The Root Condition* ^7-1-1-1-5-2-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-1]]

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, a state associated with pleasant feeling arises because of the root condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate.
Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, a state associated with painful feeling arises because of the root condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with painful feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises because of the root condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate. ^7-3-1

######## *The Object Condition and the Rest* ^7-1-1-1-5-2-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-2]]

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, a state associated with pleasant feeling arises because of the object condition… because of the predominance condition (under predominance there is no rebirth)… because of the proximity condition… because of the contiguity condition… because of the co-arising condition… because of the mutuality condition… because of the support condition… because of the strong-support condition… because of the pre-arising condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate. The physical base, because of the pre-arising condition (abbreviated). ^7-3-2

######## *The Repetition Condition and the Rest* ^7-1-1-1-5-2-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-3]]

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, a state associated with pleasant feeling arises because of the repetition condition… because of the kamma condition… because of the result condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate.
Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, a state associated with painful feeling arises because of the result condition – dependent on one aggregate accompanied by pain and accompanied by body-consciousness, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises because of the result condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate. ^7-3-3

######## *The Nutriment Condition and the Rest* ^7-1-1-1-5-2-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-4]]

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, a state associated with pleasant feeling arises because of the nutriment condition… because of the faculty condition… because of the jhāna condition… because of the path condition… because of the association condition… because of the dissociation condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate; the physical base, because of the dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate. The physical base, because of the dissociation condition.
Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling, a state associated with painful feeling arises because of the dissociation condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with painful feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate. The physical base, because of the dissociation condition.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises because of the dissociation condition – dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate; the physical base, because of the dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate. The physical base, because of the dissociation condition (abbreviated). ^7-3-4

######## *The Not-Dissociation Condition* ^7-1-1-1-5-6-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-15]]

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling, a state associated with pleasant feeling arises not because of the dissociation condition – in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate.
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises not because of the dissociation condition – in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate. ^7-3-15

######## *The Root Condition* ^7-1-1-1-5-13-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-38]]

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of root condition – roots associated with pleasant feeling are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth, roots associated with pleasant feeling are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of root condition – roots associated with painful feeling are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition – roots associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth, roots associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (1) ^7-3-38

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-1-1-1-5-13-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-39]]

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews it with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling. Having emerged from jhāna associated with pleasant feeling, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews it with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling. Noble ones, with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, review abandoned defilements associated with pleasant feeling, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. With consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one sees the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust associated with pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises; with the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling as object, aggregates associated with pleasant feeling arise. (1)
A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, distress arises in one who feels remorse. When jhāna associated with pleasant feeling has been lost, distress arises in one who feels remorse. With the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling as object, aggregates associated with painful feeling arise. (2)
A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews it with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. Having emerged from jhāna associated with pleasant feeling, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews it with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. Noble ones, with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, review abandoned defilements associated with pleasant feeling, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. With consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one sees the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness associated with pleasant feeling. Aggregates associated with pleasant feeling are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. With the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling as object, aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise. (3) ^7-3-39

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-40]]

A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of object condition – with hatred as object, hatred arises, delusion arises; with delusion associated with painful feeling as object, delusion arises, hatred arises; with body-consciousness accompanied by pain as object, hatred arises, delusion arises; with the aggregates associated with painful feeling as object, aggregates associated with painful feeling arise. (1)
A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of object condition – noble ones, with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, review abandoned defilements associated with painful feeling, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. With consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one sees the aggregates associated with painful feeling with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; with the aggregates associated with painful feeling as object, aggregates associated with pleasant feeling arise. (2)
A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of object condition – noble ones, with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, review abandoned defilements associated with painful feeling, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. With consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one sees the aggregates associated with painful feeling with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness associated with painful feeling. Aggregates associated with painful feeling are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting – with the aggregates associated with painful feeling as object, aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise. (3) ^7-3-40

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-41]]

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one reviews it with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. Having emerged from jhāna associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews it with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling; noble ones, with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, review abandoned defilements associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. With consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one sees the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises; by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. The base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. Aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. With the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling as object, aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise. (1)
A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one reviews it with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling. Having emerged from jhāna associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews it with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling. Noble ones, with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, review abandoned defilements associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. With consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one sees the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust associated with pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises; with the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling as object, aggregates associated with pleasant feeling arise. (2)
A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, distress arises in one who feels remorse, when jhāna associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling has been lost, distress arises in one who feels remorse, with the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling as object, aggregates associated with painful feeling arise. (3) ^7-3-41

######## *The Predominance Condition* ^7-1-1-1-5-13-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-42]]

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance.
Object-predominance – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews it with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, giving it weight. Having emerged from jhāna associated with pleasant feeling, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews it with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, giving it weight. With consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one enjoys and delights in the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, giving them weight; giving it weight, lust associated with pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises.
Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with pleasant feeling is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of predominance condition.
Object-predominance – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews it with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, giving it weight. Having emerged from jhāna associated with pleasant feeling, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews it with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, giving it weight. With consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one enjoys and delights in the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, giving them weight; giving it weight, lust associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises. (2) ^7-3-42

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-43]]

A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of predominance condition.

######## *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-1-1-1-5-13-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-3-53]]

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support….
Natural strong-support – relying on faith associated with pleasant feeling, with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna associated with pleasant feeling, produces insight, produces the path, produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on virtue associated with pleasant feeling… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom… on lust… on delusion… on conceit… on wrong view… on longing… on body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, with consciousness associated with pleasant feeling one gives a gift… produces an attainment (in the groups of five beginning with faith, "fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view" should be included; in the rest it should not be included). With consciousness associated with pleasant feeling, one takes what is not given, tells lies, speaks divisively, chatters idly, breaks into houses, carries off plunder, robs a single house, lies in ambush on the road, goes to another's wife, raids a village, raids a town. Faith associated with pleasant feeling… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing… body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith associated with pleasant feeling… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom… for lust… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing… for body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure… for the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling. (1)
A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of strong-support condition.
Natural strong-support – relying on faith associated with pleasant feeling, one torments and afflicts oneself, and undergoes suffering rooted in seeking. Relying on virtue associated with pleasant feeling… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom, one torments and afflicts oneself, and undergoes suffering rooted in seeking. Relying on lust associated with pleasant feeling… on delusion… on conceit… on wrong view… on longing… on body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, one kills a living being. With consciousness associated with painful feeling, one takes what is not given, tells lies, speaks divisively, speaks harshly, chatters idly, breaks into houses, carries off plunder, robs a single house, lies in ambush on the road, goes to another's wife, raids a village, raids a town, takes the life of one's mother, takes the life of one's father, takes the life of an arahant, with a malicious mind draws the Buddha's blood, causes a split in the monastic community. Faith associated with pleasant feeling… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing… body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for hatred… for delusion… for body-consciousness accompanied by pain… for the aggregates associated with painful feeling. (2)
A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support….

Relying on virtue associated with pleasant feeling… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom… on lust… on delusion… on conceit… on wrong view… on longing… on body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, with consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling one gives a gift… produces an attainment. With consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one takes what is not given, tells lies, speaks divisively, chatters idly [variant: pharusaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati (Sī., Syā.)], breaks into houses, carries off plunder, robs a single house, lies in ambush on the road, goes to another's wife, raids a village, raids a town. Faith associated with pleasant feeling… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing… body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom… for lust… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing… for the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. (3) ^7-3-53
