![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-4-1]]

Dependent on a resultant state, a resultant state arises because of the root condition – dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates. (1)
Dependent on a resultant state, a state neither resultant nor productive of results arises because of the root condition – dependent on the resultant aggregates, matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on the resultant aggregates, matter produced by kamma; dependent on the aggregates, the physical base. (2)
Dependent on a resultant state, resultant states and states neither resultant nor productive of results arise because of the root condition – dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by kamma… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and matter produced by kamma. (3) ^7-4-1

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-4-3]]

(1)
Dependent on a state neither resultant nor productive of results, a resultant state arises because of the root condition – at the moment of rebirth, dependent on the physical base, resultant aggregates. (2)
Dependent on a state neither resultant nor productive of results, resultant states and states neither resultant nor productive of results arise because of the root condition – at the moment of rebirth, dependent on the physical base, resultant aggregates; dependent on the great elements, matter produced by kamma. Post-arising – aggregates productive of results and physical food are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body that arose earlier. ######## *The Object Condition* ^7-1-1-1-7-29-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-5-52]]

A state clung-to and subject to clinging is a condition for a state clung-to and subject to clinging by way of object condition – trainees or ordinary people see the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, they enjoy and delight in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises; when the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result arises as registration. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms clung-to and subject to clinging… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… they see the aggregates clung-to and subject to clinging with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, they enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. When the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result arises as registration. The visible-form base clung-to and subject to clinging is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the odour base clung-to and subject to clinging… the taste base… the tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for body-consciousness. (1)
A state clung-to and subject to clinging is a condition for a state not clung-to but subject to clinging by way of object condition – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, one enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms clung-to and subject to clinging… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… one sees the aggregates clung-to and subject to clinging with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, one enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. With the divine eye one sees a visible form clung-to and subject to clinging; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness clung-to and subject to clinging. Aggregates clung-to and subject to clinging are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (2) ^7-5-52

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-5-53]]

A state not clung-to but subject to clinging is a condition for a state not clung-to but subject to clinging by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; noble ones review change-of-lineage, they review cleansing; noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; visible forms not clung-to but subject to clinging… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the aggregates not clung-to but subject to clinging they see with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, they enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. With the divine eye they see a visible form not clung-to but subject to clinging, with the divine ear element they hear a sound, by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not clung-to but subject to clinging. The base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. Aggregates not clung-to but subject to clinging are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)

The wholesome state of the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the resultant state of the base of infinite consciousness. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms clung-to and subject to clinging… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… giving the aggregates clung-to and subject to clinging weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Visible forms not clung-to but subject to clinging… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the aggregates not clung-to but subject to clinging, giving them weight, they enjoy and delight in them; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

A state neither clung-to nor subject to clinging is a condition for a state not clung-to but subject to clinging by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage and for cleansing. A state clung-to and subject to clinging is a condition for a state clung-to and subject to clinging by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising – one aggregate clung-to and subject to clinging is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates… two aggregates are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth, one aggregate clung-to and subject to clinging is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by kamma… two aggregates are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. The aggregates for the physical base… the physical base for the aggregates… one great element… The great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma and derived matter. For non-percipient beings, one great element… the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma and derived matter.
Pre-arising – trainees or ordinary people see the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they enjoy and delight in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. When the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result arises as registration. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms clung-to and subject to clinging… odours… tastes… tangible objects… they see the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they enjoy and delight in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. When the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result arises as registration. The visible-form base clung-to and subject to clinging for eye-consciousness… the odour base clung-to and subject to clinging… the taste base… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates clung-to and subject to clinging.
Post-arising – aggregates clung-to and subject to clinging are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body that arose earlier and is clung-to and subject to clinging. Physical food clung-to and subject to clinging is a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body clung-to and subject to clinging. The material life faculty is a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. (1)

Pre-arising – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. One sees a visible form clung-to and subject to clinging with the divine eye. The physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates not clung-to but subject to clinging. Post-arising – aggregates clung-to and subject to clinging are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body that arose earlier and is not clung-to but subject to clinging. (3)

(1)

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-1-1-1-8-10-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-6-9]]

A state defiled and subject to defilement is a condition for a state defiled and subject to defilement by way of object condition – one enjoys and delights in lust; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, distress arises. One enjoys and delights in wrong view… with doubt as object… with restlessness as object… with distress as object…. (1)
(Just as it was set out in the wholesome triad, so it should be set out.)
A state defiled and subject to defilement is a condition for a state undefiled but subject to defilement by way of object condition – noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; they see the aggregates defiled and subject to defilement with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness defiled and subject to defilement; trainees or ordinary people see the aggregates defiled and subject to defilement with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; when the wholesome has ceased, a result arises as registration; they enjoy and delight in the aggregates defiled and subject to defilement… distress arises; when the unwholesome has ceased, a result arises as registration. Aggregates defiled and subject to defilement are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (2) ^7-6-9

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-6-10]]

A state undefiled but subject to defilement is a condition for a state undefiled but subject to defilement by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; noble ones review change-of-lineage, they review cleansing; they see the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; the ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… they see the physical base and the aggregates undefiled but subject to defilement with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they see a visible form with the divine eye, hear a sound with the divine ear element, and by knowledge of others' minds know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness undefiled but subject to defilement. The base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for body-consciousness. Aggregates undefiled but subject to defilement are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A state undefiled but subject to defilement is a condition for a state defiled and subject to defilement by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises… distress arises; one enjoys good deeds done in the past… having emerged from jhāna, one enjoys the jhāna… one enjoys the eye. Tangible objects… the physical base… one enjoys and delights in the aggregates undefiled but subject to defilement; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. (2)
A state neither defiled nor subject to defilement is a condition for a state neither defiled nor subject to defilement by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path and for fruit. (1)
A state neither defiled nor subject to defilement is a condition for a state undefiled but subject to defilement by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review fruit, review nibbāna. (5)
(In the two remaining combinations, the course of life and rebirth should be expanded.)
The root condition.
(The Condition Section should be expanded by working through the root condition. It should be counted in the same way as the dependence count. Predominance: thirty-seven; pre-arising and repetition: twenty-one; this is the difference here.) ^7-7-48

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-49]]

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-50]]

Seven questions based on a state with applied and sustained thought are to be worked out for the not-predominance condition.
With a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only as condition, a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only arises not because of the predominance condition – with the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only as condition, predominance without applied thought, with sustained thought only; with one resultant aggregate without applied thought, with sustained thought only as condition, three aggregates… at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
With a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only as condition (as in the dependence method, so five questions are to be worked out). ^7-7-50

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-51]]

With a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, a state without applied or sustained thought arises… with the aggregates without applied or sustained thought as condition, predominance without applied or sustained thought; with one resultant aggregate without applied or sustained thought as condition, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… with resultant sustained thought as condition, matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth… with the physical base as condition, predominance without applied or sustained thought; with the physical base as condition, resultant aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought…. (1)
With a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, a state with applied and sustained thought… with the physical base as condition, aggregates with applied and sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth…. (2)
With a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only… with sustained thought as condition, predominance without applied thought, with sustained thought only; with the physical base as condition, predominance without applied thought, with sustained thought only; with resultant sustained thought as condition, aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only; with the physical base as condition, resultant aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only. At the moment of rebirth…. (3)
With a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied or sustained thought… with the physical base as condition, aggregates with applied and sustained thought; with the great elements as condition, matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth…. (4)
With a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, states without applied thought, with sustained thought only and states without applied or sustained thought… with resultant sustained thought as condition, aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and matter produced by consciousness; with the physical base as condition, resultant aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only; with the great elements as condition, matter produced by consciousness; with the physical base as condition, applied thought; with the great elements as condition, matter produced by consciousness; with the physical base as condition, resultant aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth…. (5)
With a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, states with applied and sustained thought and states without applied thought, with sustained thought only… with the physical base as condition, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought. At the moment of rebirth…. (6)
(In the first combination, seven complete questions are to be worked out.) ^7-7-51

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-52]]

With a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only and a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, a state with applied and sustained thought arises… with applied thought and the physical base as condition, aggregates with applied and sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth….
With a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only and a state without applied or sustained thought as condition, a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only arises… with the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and sustained thought as condition, predominance without applied thought, with sustained thought only; with the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and the physical base as condition, predominance without applied thought, with sustained thought only; with one resultant aggregate without applied thought, with sustained thought only and sustained thought as condition… with one resultant aggregate without applied thought, with sustained thought only and the physical base as condition, three aggregates….
(At the moment of rebirth, five questions are to be worked out. Where a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only occurs, there result is to be worked out. In the series based on the not-predominance condition, thirty-seven questions are to be worked out.) ^7-7-52

######## *The Not-Proximity Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-1-14-2-0

The not-proximity [variant: naanantarepi (Ka.)], the not-contiguity, the not-mutuality and the not-strong-support conditions too: seven questions, of matter only. Not-pre-arising: thirty-seven, the same as the negative method of the Dependence Section. Not-post-arising: thirty-seven; the not-repetition condition is also the same. Where a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only also occurs, there results are to be worked out. ^7-7-53

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-1-26-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-69]]

A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna with applied and sustained thought, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews fruit. Noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. They see the aggregates with applied and sustained thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. With the aggregates with applied and sustained thought as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. (1)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; with that as object, applied thought arises. One reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna with applied and sustained thought, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews fruit; with that as object, applied thought arises. Noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. They see the aggregates with applied and sustained thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, applied thought arises. With the aggregates with applied and sustained thought as object, applied thought arises. (2)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of object condition – by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness with applied and sustained thought; aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and knowledge of the future. With the aggregates with applied and sustained thought as object, aggregates without applied or sustained thought arise. (3)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. One reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna with applied and sustained thought, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews fruit; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. Noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. They see the aggregates with applied and sustained thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. With the aggregates with applied and sustained thought as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. (4) ^7-7-69

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-70]]

A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only by way of object condition – having emerged from jhāna without applied thought, with sustained thought only, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews fruit; with that as object, applied thought arises. One sees the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and applied thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, applied thought arises. A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of object condition – having emerged from jhāna without applied thought, with sustained thought only, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, they review fruit; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. One sees the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and applied thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. With the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and applied thought as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. (2)
A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of object condition – by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness without applied thought, with sustained thought only. Aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and knowledge of the future. With the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and applied thought as object, aggregates without applied or sustained thought arise. (3)
A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only by way of object condition – having emerged from jhāna without applied thought, with sustained thought only, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, one reviews fruit; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. One sees the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and applied thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. With the aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only and applied thought as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. (4) ^7-7-70

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-71]]

A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path and fruit without applied or sustained thought and for sustained thought. One sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element, by knowledge of others' minds knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness without applied or sustained thought. The base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for body-consciousness. Aggregates without applied or sustained thought are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and knowledge of the future. With the aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought as object, aggregates without applied or sustained thought arise. (1)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from jhāna without applied or sustained thought, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, review fruit; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. Noble ones review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, cleansing, the path and fruit with applied and sustained thought, and adverting. One sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… one sees the aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. With the aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought arise. (2)

One sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… the physical base… one sees the aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, applied thought arises. With the aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought as object, applied thought arises. (3)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only and a state without applied or sustained thought by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path and fruit without applied thought, with sustained thought only and for sustained thought. (4)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from jhāna without applied or sustained thought, having emerged from the path, having emerged from fruit, review fruit; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. Noble ones review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage and applied thought, for cleansing and applied thought, for the path with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, for fruit with applied and sustained thought and applied thought, and for adverting and applied thought. One sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. Relying on virtue with applied and sustained thought… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom… on lust… on hatred… on delusion… on conceit… on wrong view… on longing, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna with applied and sustained thought, produces insight, produces the path… produces an attainment… kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community. Faith with applied and sustained thought… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith with applied and sustained thought… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom… for lust… for hatred… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing…. ######## *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-2-1-1-1-26-11-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-107]]

A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element; the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for body-consciousness. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates without applied or sustained thought and for sustained thought. (1)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… tangible objects… sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought. (2)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, applied thought arises… sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, applied thought arises. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for applied thought. (3)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and a state without applied or sustained thought by way of pre-arising condition. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for sustained thought. (4)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought. (5) ^7-7-107

A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of repetition condition – preceding aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following aggregates with applied and sustained thought. Conformity for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… change-of-lineage for the path with applied and sustained thought… cleansing is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for the path with applied and sustained thought. (1)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of repetition condition – preceding aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following applied thought. The preliminary work for jhāna without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for jhāna without applied thought, with sustained thought only. Change-of-lineage is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for the path without applied thought, with sustained thought only. Cleansing is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for the path without applied thought, with sustained thought only. (2)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of repetition condition – the preliminary work for the second jhāna is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for sustained thought in the second jhāna. (3)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and a state without applied or sustained thought by way of repetition condition – the preliminary work for jhāna without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for jhāna without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for sustained thought. Change-of-lineage for the path without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for sustained thought… cleansing is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for the path without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for sustained thought. (4)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of repetition condition – preceding aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following aggregates with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought. Conformity for change-of-lineage and for applied thought… conformity for cleansing and for applied thought… change-of-lineage for the path with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought… cleansing is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for the path with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought. A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by kamma. Post-arising – aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for this body that arose earlier. (1)
A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by consciousness; applied thought is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by kamma. Applied thought is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by kamma. Post-arising – aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and applied thought are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for this body that arose earlier. (1) ^7-7-127

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-128]]

Sustained thought is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, aggregates without applied or sustained thought are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by kamma. Sustained thought is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by kamma; the aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the physical base, the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the aggregates; sustained thought is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the physical base; the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for sustained thought. Pre-arising – the eye base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for body-consciousness; the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for aggregates without applied or sustained thought and for sustained thought. Post-arising – aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for this body that arose earlier. (1)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Pre-arising – the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought. (2)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – at the moment of rebirth, the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought. Pre-arising – the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought. (5) ^7-7-128

######## *The Presence Condition* ^7-2-1-1-1-26-22-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-130]]

A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of presence condition – one aggregate with applied and sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates… two aggregates for two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of presence condition – aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of presence condition, for applied thought. At the moment of rebirth…. (2)
A state with applied and sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of presence condition – co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. Post-arising – aggregates with applied and sustained thought are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body that arose earlier. (3)
(Among the questions based on a state with applied and sustained thought, the remaining questions are the same as the co-arising condition.) ^7-7-130

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-131]]

A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of presence condition – one aggregate without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates… two aggregates for two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of presence condition – applied thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought. At the moment of rebirth…. (2)
A state without applied thought, with sustained thought only is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of presence condition – co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only are a condition, by way of presence condition, for sustained thought and for matter produced by consciousness. Applied thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only are a condition, by way of presence condition, for sustained thought and for matter produced by kamma; applied thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. (The five questions based on a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only. The remaining ones are the same as the co-arising condition.) ^7-7-131

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-7-132]]

A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied or sustained thought by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising – one aggregate without applied or sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates for two aggregates… sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, one aggregate without applied or sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by kamma… the aggregates are a condition, by way of presence condition, for the physical base, the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the aggregates; sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the physical base, the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for sustained thought; one great element is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three great elements… the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three great elements… the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma and derived matter. Pre-arising – one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element; the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for body-consciousness, the eye base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for body-consciousness. The physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied or sustained thought and for sustained thought. Post-arising – aggregates without applied or sustained thought and sustained thought are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body that arose earlier. Physical food is a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body. The material life faculty is a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. (1)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – at the moment of rebirth, the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought. Pre-arising – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… distress arises. The physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought. (2)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only. At the moment of rebirth, sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only. At the moment of rebirth, the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for applied thought. Pre-arising – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, applied thought arises. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, applied thought arises. The physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for applied thought. (3)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and a state without applied or sustained thought by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, sustained thought is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for matter produced by kamma. At the moment of rebirth, the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for sustained thought. Pre-arising – the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates without applied thought, with sustained thought only, and for sustained thought. (4)
A state without applied or sustained thought is a condition for a state with applied and sustained thought and a state without applied thought, with sustained thought only, by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – at the moment of rebirth, the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought. Pre-arising – one sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, aggregates with applied and sustained thought and applied thought arise. The physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates with applied and sustained thought and for applied thought. (5) ^7-7-132

Noble ones, with consciousness accompanied by rapture, review abandoned defilements accompanied by rapture, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. With consciousness accompanied by rapture, they see the aggregates accompanied by rapture with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, they enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, lust accompanied by rapture arises, wrong view arises. With the aggregates accompanied by rapture as object, aggregates accompanied by rapture arise. (1)

A state accompanied by rapture is a condition for a state accompanied by rapture by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith accompanied by rapture, with consciousness accompanied by rapture one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna accompanied by rapture, produces insight, produces the path, produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on virtue accompanied by rapture… on learning… on generosity… on wisdom, with consciousness accompanied by rapture one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts… fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on lust accompanied by rapture… on delusion… on conceit… on wrong view… on longing, with consciousness accompanied by rapture one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna accompanied by rapture… produces an attainment. With consciousness accompanied by rapture, one takes what is not given, tells lies, speaks divisively, chatters idly, breaks into houses, carries off plunder, robs a single house, lies in ambush on the road, goes to another's wife, raids a village, raids a town. Faith accompanied by rapture… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith accompanied by rapture… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom… for lust… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing. A state leading to accumulation [variant: ācayagāmi (Sī., Syā.) evamuparipi] is a condition for a state leading to accumulation by way of root condition – roots leading to accumulation are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state leading to accumulation is a condition for a state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal by way of root condition – roots leading to accumulation are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state leading to accumulation is a condition for a state leading to accumulation and a state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal by way of root condition – roots leading to accumulation are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3)
A state leading to dispersal is a condition for a state leading to dispersal by way of root condition… three.
A state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal is a condition for a state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal by way of root condition – roots leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, roots leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. (1) ^7-11-45

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-5-38-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-11-46]]

A state leading to accumulation is a condition for a state leading to accumulation by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna. Trainees review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. Trainees or ordinary people see the aggregates leading to accumulation with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, they enjoy and delight in them, with that as object lust arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… distress arises, by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness leading to accumulation. The wholesome state of the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the wholesome state of the base of infinite consciousness. The wholesome state of the base of nothingness is a condition for the wholesome state of the base of neither perception nor non-perception… aggregates leading to accumulation are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and knowledge of the future. (1)
A state leading to accumulation is a condition for a state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal by way of object condition – an arahant reviews abandoned defilements, knows the defilements habitually indulged in before, sees the aggregates leading to accumulation with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; by knowledge of others' minds he knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness leading to accumulation. Trainees or ordinary people see the aggregates leading to accumulation with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, when the wholesome has ceased resultant registration arises, they enjoy and delight in the aggregates leading to accumulation, with that as object lust arises… distress arises, when the unwholesome has ceased resultant registration arises. The wholesome state of the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the resultant and the functional states of the base of infinite consciousness. The wholesome state of the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the resultant and the functional states of the base of neither perception nor non-perception. Aggregates leading to accumulation are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (2) ^7-11-46

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-11-47]]

A state leading to dispersal is a condition for a state leading to accumulation by way of object condition – trainees, having emerged from the path, review the path; by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness leading to dispersal; aggregates leading to dispersal are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future. (1)
A state leading to dispersal is a condition for a state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal by way of object condition – an arahant, having emerged from the path, reviews the path; by knowledge of others' minds he knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness leading to dispersal; aggregates leading to dispersal are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (2) ^7-11-47

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-11-48]]

A state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal is a condition for a state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal by way of object condition – an arahant reviews fruit, reviews nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for fruit and for adverting. An arahant sees the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; the ear… the physical base… sees the aggregates leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element, by knowledge of others' minds knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal. The functional state of the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the functional state of the base of infinite consciousness. The functional state of the base of nothingness is a condition for the functional state of the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… aggregates leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal is a condition for a state leading to accumulation by way of object condition – trainees review fruit, review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage and for cleansing. Trainees or ordinary people see the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoy and delight in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. The ear… the physical base… they see the aggregates leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt… restlessness… distress… they see a visible form with the divine eye, hear a sound with the divine ear element, by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal, aggregates leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future. (2)
A state leading neither to accumulation nor to dispersal is a condition for a state leading to dispersal by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path. (3) ^7-11-48

Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing and for adverting. Noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; they see the eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they enjoy and delight in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises; the ear… the physical base and the aggregates of neither a trainee nor one beyond training, they see with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, they enjoy and delight in them… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element, knows by knowledge of others' minds the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness of neither a trainee nor one beyond training; the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… aggregates of neither a trainee nor one beyond training are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-7-29-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-13-56]]

A limited state is a condition for a limited state by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; noble ones review change-of-lineage, they review cleansing, they review defilements that have been abandoned, they review defilements that have been suppressed, they know defilements that occurred in the past. A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state fixed in rightness by way of root condition… three.
A state not fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of root condition – roots not fixed are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth…. (1) ^7-16-36

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-10-38-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-37]]

A state fixed in wrongness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of object condition – noble ones review the defilements fixed in wrongness that have been abandoned, and they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. They see the aggregates fixed in wrongness as impermanent… with insight. By knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness fixed in wrongness. Aggregates fixed in wrongness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path. By knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness fixed in rightness. Aggregates fixed in rightness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-16-37

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-38]]

A state not fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; noble ones review fruit, they review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for fruit and for adverting. Noble ones review the defilements not fixed that have been abandoned, they review the defilements that have been suppressed. They know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. The eye… the physical base… they see the aggregates not fixed with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, lust not fixed arises… distress arises. With the divine eye one sees a visible form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound, by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not fixed; the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness. Aggregates not fixed are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A state not fixed is a condition for a state fixed in wrongness by way of object condition – the material life faculty is a condition, by way of object condition, for the act of killing one's mother… the act of killing one's father… the act of killing an arahant… the act of drawing the Buddha's blood. For one who grasps at a physical base, aggregates fixed in wrongness arise; that physical base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the aggregates fixed in wrongness. (2)
A state not fixed is a condition for a state fixed in rightness by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path. (3) ^7-16-38

######## *The Predominance Condition* ^7-2-1-1-10-38-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-39]]

A state fixed in wrongness is a condition for a state fixed in wrongness by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed in wrongness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state fixed in wrongness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed in wrongness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state fixed in wrongness is a condition for a state fixed in wrongness and a state not fixed by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed in wrongness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-16-39

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-40]]

A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state fixed in rightness by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed in rightness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, giving it weight. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed in rightness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state fixed in rightness and a state not fixed by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed in rightness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-16-40

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-41]]

A state not fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, giving it weight; one reviews good deeds done in the past, giving them weight; having emerged from jhāna… noble ones review fruit, giving it weight, they review nibbāna, giving it weight; nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing and for fruit. The eye… the physical base…, giving the aggregates not fixed weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving that weight, lust not fixed arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance not fixed is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)
A state not fixed is a condition for a state fixed in rightness by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the path. (2) ^7-16-41

######## *The Proximity Condition* ^7-2-1-1-10-38-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-42]]

A state fixed in wrongness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of proximity condition – aggregates fixed in wrongness are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for emergence. (1)
A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of proximity condition – the path is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for fruit. (1)
A state not fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates not fixed are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates not fixed. Conformity for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… fruit for fruit… conformity for the attainment of fruition… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the attainment of fruition. ######## *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-2-1-1-10-38-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-45]]

A state fixed in wrongness is a condition for a state fixed in wrongness by way of strong-support condition. Natural strong-support – the act of killing one's mother is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's mother. The act of killing one's mother… the act of killing one's father… the act of killing an arahant… the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… the act of splitting the monastic community… is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for fixed wrong view (the cycle should be worked out). Fixed wrong view is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for fixed wrong view. Fixed wrong view is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's mother… for the act of splitting the monastic community. (1)
A state fixed in wrongness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of strong-support condition – proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – having taken the life of one's mother, in order to counteract it one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. Having taken the life of one's father… having taken the life of an arahant… having drawn the Buddha's blood with a malicious mind… having split the monastic community, in order to counteract it one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. (2) ^7-16-45

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-16-46]]

A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state fixed in rightness by way of strong-support condition. (1)
A state fixed in rightness is a condition for a state not fixed by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – noble ones, relying on the path, produce an attainment that has not yet arisen, enter one that has arisen, and see formations with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. The path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the noble ones' analytical knowledge of meaning… skill in what is possible and what is impossible. The path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the attainment of fruition. (2) ^7-16-46

Lust not fixed… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's mother… for the act of killing one's father… for the act of killing an arahant… for the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… for the act of splitting the monastic community… for fixed wrong view.
