######## *The Root Condition* ^7-2-1-1-12-3-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-1]]

An arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of root condition – arisen roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, arisen roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. (1) ^7-18-1

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-12-3-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-2]]

An arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of object condition – one sees the arisen eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt… restlessness… distress arises. The arisen ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… one sees the arisen aggregates with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… distress arises. One sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element; the visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… arisen aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers and for adverting. (1) ^7-18-2

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-3]]

A not-arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of object condition – one sees not-arisen visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… not-arisen aggregates with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… distress arises. Not-arisen aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-18-3

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-4]]

A state bound to arise is a condition for an arisen state by way of object condition – one sees the eye bound to arise… the body… visible forms… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… aggregates bound to arise with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… distress arises. Aggregates bound to arise are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-18-4

######## *The Predominance Condition* ^7-2-1-1-12-3-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-5]]

An arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving the arisen eye weight, one enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. The arisen ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… giving the arisen aggregates weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises…. Co-arising predominance – arisen predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)
A not-arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – not-arisen visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… giving not-arisen aggregates weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)
A state bound to arise is a condition for an arisen state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving the eye bound to arise weight… the body… visible forms… tangible objects… the physical base… giving aggregates bound to arise weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1) ^7-18-5

######## *The Co-arising Condition* ^7-2-1-1-12-3-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-6]]

An arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of co-arising condition – one arisen aggregate is a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates are a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for two aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, one arisen aggregate is a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by kamma… two aggregates are a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for two aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. The aggregates are a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for the physical base. The physical base is a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for the aggregates. One great element is a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for three great elements… two great elements… the great elements are a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter. External… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, one great element… two great elements… the great elements are a condition, by way of co-arising condition, for matter produced by kamma and derived matter. (1) ^7-18-6

######## *The Mutuality Condition* ^7-2-1-1-12-3-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-7]]

An arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of mutuality condition – one arisen aggregate is a condition, by way of mutuality condition, for three aggregates… two aggregates… At the moment of rebirth, one arisen aggregate is a condition, by way of mutuality condition, for three aggregates and for the physical base. Two aggregates… the aggregates are a condition, by way of mutuality condition, for the physical base. The physical base is a condition, by way of mutuality condition, for the aggregates. One great element… external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition, by way of mutuality condition, for three great elements… two great elements…. (1) ^7-18-7

######## *The Support Condition* ^7-2-1-1-12-3-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-8]]

An arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of support condition – one arisen aggregate is a condition, by way of support condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… the aggregates for the physical base… the physical base for the aggregates… one great element… external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, one great element… the great elements are a condition, by way of support condition, for matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter. The eye base is a condition, by way of support condition, for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of support condition, for arisen aggregates. (1) ^7-18-8

######## *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-2-1-1-12-3-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-9]]

An arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support… Natural strong-support – relying on the arisen temperature, one produces jhāna, produces insight… the path… higher knowledge… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on the arisen food… lodging, one produces jhāna, produces insight… the path… higher knowledge… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Arisen temperature… food… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for arisen faith… wisdom, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A not-arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – longing for not-arisen excellence of complexion, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. Longing for not-arisen excellence of sound… odour… taste… tangible objects… not-arisen aggregates, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. Not-arisen excellence of complexion… not-arisen aggregates are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for arisen faith… wisdom, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A state bound to arise is a condition for an arisen state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – longing for excellence of the eye bound to arise, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. Longing for excellence of the ear bound to arise… the body… complexion… odour… taste… tangible objects… aggregates bound to arise, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties. Excellence of the eye bound to arise… the body… complexion… tangible objects… aggregates bound to arise are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for arisen faith… wisdom, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (1) ^7-18-9

Root: one, object: three, predominance: three, co-arising: one, mutuality: one, support: one, strong-support: three, pre-arising: one, post-arising, kamma, result, nutriment, faculty, jhāna, path, association, dissociation, presence, non-disappearance: one (it should be counted in this way).
The positive method. ^7-18-19

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-18-20]]

A not-arisen state is a condition for an arisen state by way of object condition, by way of strong-support condition. (1)
A state bound to arise is a condition for an arisen state by way of object condition… by way of strong-support condition. (1) ^7-18-20

###### The Past Triad ^7-2-1-1-13-0

####### *The Analysis Section* ^7-2-1-1-13-1-0

####### *Positive Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-13-2-0

####### *The Exposition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-0

######## *The Root Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-1]]

A present state is a condition for a present state by way of root condition – present roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth…. (1) ^7-19-1

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-2]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties… one reviews it, one reviews good deeds done in the past, having emerged from jhāna one reviews the jhāna. Noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, they review fruit, they review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. One sees the past eye with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… distress arises. The past ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… one sees the past aggregates with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them, with that as object lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt… restlessness… distress arises; the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. Past aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, and adverting. (1) ^7-19-2

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-3]]

A future state is a condition for a present state by way of object condition – the future eye… the physical base… one sees the future aggregates with insight as impermanent… distress arises. Future aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A present state is a condition for a present state by way of object condition – the present eye… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… one sees the present aggregates with insight as impermanent… distress arises, one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element, the visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… present aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers and for adverting. (1) ^7-19-3

######## *The Predominance Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-4]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – after giving a gift and undertaking the precepts… one reviews good deeds done in the past, giving them weight; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, giving it weight. Noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, giving it weight; they review fruit, giving it weight. The past eye… the body… visible forms… sounds… odours… tastes… tangible objects… the physical base… one enjoys and delights in the past aggregates, giving them weight; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1) A future state is a condition for a present state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – the future eye… the physical base… one enjoys and delights in the future aggregates, giving them weight; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)
A present state is a condition for a present state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – the present eye… the physical base… one enjoys and delights in the present aggregates, giving them weight; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – present predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1) ^7-19-4

######## *The Proximity Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-5]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of proximity condition – preceding past aggregates are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following present aggregates. Conformity for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing for the path… the path for fruit… fruit for fruit… conformity for the attainment of fruition… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the attainment of fruition. (1) ^7-19-5

######## *The Contiguity Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-6]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of contiguity condition (the same as the proximity condition). (1) ^7-19-6

######## *The Co-arising Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-7]]

A present state is a condition for a present state by way of co-arising condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition (abbreviated). (1) ^7-19-7

######## *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-8]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on past faith, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna, produces insight… the path… higher knowledge… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on past virtue… wisdom… lust… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties… produces an attainment, kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community. Past faith… wisdom, lust… longing, bodily pleasure… bodily pain… are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for present faith… wisdom, for lust… longing… for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A future state is a condition for a present state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – longing for the future excellence of the eye… the excellence of the ear… the excellence of the nose, the excellence of the tongue… the excellence of the body… the excellence of complexion… the excellence of sound… the excellence of odour… the excellence of taste… the excellence of the tangible… longing… longing for the future aggregates, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties… Future excellence of the eye… of complexion… of the tangible… future aggregates are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for present faith… wisdom, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path and for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A present state is a condition for a present state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on present climate, one produces jhāna, produces insight… relying on present food and lodging, one produces jhāna… produces an attainment. Present climate… food… lodging are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for present faith… wisdom, for the bodily… for the attainment of fruition. (1) ^7-19-8

######## *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-9]]

A present state is a condition for a present state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… one sees the physical base with insight as impermanent… distress arises, one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element; the visible-form base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for present aggregates. (1) ^7-19-9

######## *The Post-arising Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-9-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-10]]

A present state is a condition for a present state by way of post-arising condition – post-arising present aggregates are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this body that arose earlier. (1) ^7-19-10

######## *The Repetition Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-10-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-11]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of repetition condition – preceding past aggregates are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following present aggregates. Conformity for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for the path. (1) ^7-19-11

######## *The Kamma Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-11-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-12]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of kamma condition. From a different moment – past volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for present resultant aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. (1)
A present state is a condition for a present state by way of kamma condition – present volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, present volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. (1) ^7-19-12

######## *The Result Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-12-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-13]]

A present state is a condition for a present state by way of result condition – one present resultant aggregate is a condition, by way of result condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… aggregates are a condition, by way of result condition, for the physical base. (1) ^7-19-13

######## *The Nutriment Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-13-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-14]]

A present state is a condition for a present state by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition… by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition… by way of association condition… by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – present aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, present aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for matter produced by kamma, aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the physical base, the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the aggregates. Pre-arising – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for present aggregates. Post-arising – present aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for this body that arose earlier. (1) ^7-19-14

######## *The Presence Condition* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-14-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-15]]

A present state is a condition for a present state by way of presence condition (the same as the presence condition in the Arisen Triad). (1) ^7-19-15

######## *The Absence, Disappearance and Non-disappearance Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-13-3-15-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-19-16]]

A past state is a condition for a present state by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition.
A present state is a condition for a present state by way of non-disappearance condition…. ^7-19-16

A future state is a condition for a present state by way of object condition… by way of strong-support condition. (1)
A present state is a condition for a present state by way of object condition… by way of co-arising condition… by way of strong-support condition… by way of pre-arising condition… by way of post-arising condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1) ^7-19-18

The negative method. ^7-19-19

Dependent on a state with a past object, a state with a past object arises because of the root condition – dependent on one aggregate with a past object, three aggregates… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates. Dependent on a state with a past object, a state with a past object arises because of the object condition… because of the predominance condition (in predominance there is no rebirth)… because of the proximity condition… because of the contiguity condition… because of the co-arising condition… because of the mutuality condition… because of the support condition… because of the strong-support condition… because of the pre-arising condition… because of the repetition condition (in pre-arising and in repetition there is no rebirth)… because of the kamma condition… because of the result condition (a result: one aggregate with a past object; all three questions are complete. The course of existence and rebirth are to be worked out)… because of the nutriment condition… because of the faculty condition… because of the jhāna condition… because of the path condition… because of the association condition… because of the dissociation condition… because of the presence condition… because of the absence condition… because of the disappearance condition… because of the non-disappearance condition. ^7-20-4

A state with a future object is a condition for a state with a future object by way of root condition – roots with a future object are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-14-15-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-20-20]]

A state with a past object is a condition for a state with a past object by way of object condition – one reviews the past base of infinite consciousness, one reviews the base of neither perception nor non-perception. One reviews past knowledge of supernormal powers with a past object, knowledge of others' minds… knowledge of recollecting past lives… one reviews knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma. Noble ones review abandoned defilements with a past object, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before. One sees the past aggregates with a past object with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust with a past object arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… distress arises. Past aggregates with a past object are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and adverting. (1)
A state with a past object is a condition for a state with a future object by way of object condition – one reviews the future base of infinite consciousness, one reviews the base of neither perception nor non-perception. One sees the future aggregates with a past object as impermanent… with insight, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust with a future object arises… distress arises. Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the root condition – dependent on one internal aggregate without roots, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth without roots… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates. One great element… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings, one great element… dependent on the great elements, matter produced by kamma and derived matter. Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness. (1)
Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the root condition – dependent on one external aggregate without roots, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth without roots… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates. Dependent on one great element… the external… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element… dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness. (1) ^7-21-7

######## *The Not-Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-7-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-8]]

Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the object condition – dependent on the internal aggregates, matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, dependent on the internal aggregates, matter produced by kamma. Dependent on the aggregates, the physical base… dependent on one great element… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element…. (1)
Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the object condition – dependent on the external aggregates, matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, dependent on the external aggregates, matter produced by kamma. Dependent on the aggregates, the physical base… one great element… the external… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. (1) ^7-21-8

######## *The Not-Predominance Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-15-7-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-9]]

Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the predominance condition… (the same as the positive co-arising, without difference) not because of the proximity condition… not because of the contiguity condition… not because of the mutuality condition… not because of the strong-support condition, not because of the pre-arising condition – in the immaterial realm, dependent on one internal aggregate… dependent on the internal aggregates, matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, dependent on one internal aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by kamma… dependent on two aggregates… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates. Dependent on one great element… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. ^7-21-9

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-10]]

Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the pre-arising condition – in the immaterial realm, dependent on one external aggregate… dependent on two aggregates… dependent on the external aggregates, matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth (complete), one great element… the external… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. ^7-21-10

######## *The Not-Post-arising Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-15-7-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-11]]

Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the post-arising condition, not because of the repetition condition, not because of the kamma condition – dependent on the internal aggregates, internal volition. Matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature…. (1)
Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the kamma condition – dependent on the external aggregates, external volition. The external… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature…. (1) ^7-21-11

######## *The Not-Result Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-15-7-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-12]]

Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the result condition (there is no rebirth), not because of the nutriment condition – matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. (1)
Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the nutriment condition – the external… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. (1)
Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the faculty condition – matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings… dependent on the great elements, the material life faculty. (1)
Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the faculty condition – the external… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings… dependent on the great elements, the material life faculty. (1) ^7-21-12

######## *The Not-Jhāna Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-7-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-13]]

Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the jhāna condition – that accompanied by the five kinds of sense-consciousness… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. (1)
Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the jhāna condition – that accompanied by the five kinds of sense-consciousness… the external… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. (1) ^7-21-13

######## *The Not-Path Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-15-7-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-14]]

Dependent on an internal state, an internal state arises not because of the path condition… (the same as the not-root condition; there is no delusion) not because of the association condition… not because of the dissociation condition – in the immaterial realm… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings…. (1)
Dependent on an external state, an external state arises not because of the dissociation condition – in the immaterial realm… the external… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings… not because of the absence condition, not because of the disappearance condition. ^7-21-14

####### *Negative Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-8-0

####### *The Counting* ^7-2-1-1-15-9-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-15]]

Not-root: two, not-object: two, not-predominance: two, not-proximity: two, not-contiguity: two (abbreviated, two in every case), not-disappearance: two (it should be counted in this way).
The negative method. ^7-21-15

####### *Positive-Negative Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-10-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-16]]

With root as condition – not-object: two… not-result, not-association, not-dissociation, not-absence, not-disappearance: two (it should be counted in this way).
The positive-negative method. ^7-21-16

####### *Negative-Positive Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-11-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-17]]

With not-root as condition – object: two, proximity: two… path: two… non-disappearance: two (it should be counted in this way).
The negative-positive method.
The dependence section. ^7-21-17

####### *The Co-arising Section* ^7-2-1-1-15-12-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-U317]]

(The co-arising section is the same as the dependence section.) ^7-U317

####### *The Condition Section* ^7-2-1-1-15-13-0

######## *The Root Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-15-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-18]]

With an internal state as condition, an internal state arises because of the root condition – with one internal aggregate as condition, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… with two aggregates as condition… at the moment of rebirth (complete). One great element… with the physical base as condition, the internal aggregates. (1)
With an external state as condition, an external state arises because of the root condition – with one external aggregate as condition, three aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… one great element… with the physical base as condition, the external aggregates. (1) ^7-21-18

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-15-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-19]]

With an internal state as condition, an internal state arises because of the object condition (the same as the dependence section), with the eye base as condition, eye-consciousness… with the body base as condition, body-consciousness… with the physical base as condition, the internal aggregates. (1)
With an external state as condition, an external state arises because of the object condition (the same as the dependence section), the eye base… the body base… with the physical base as condition, the external aggregates. (1) ^7-21-19

######## *The Predominance Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-15-15-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-20]]

With an internal state as condition, an internal state arises because of the predominance condition… (the physical base is additional, the same as the dependence section) because of the proximity condition… because of the contiguity condition… because of the co-arising condition… (complete in the co-arising section) with the great elements as condition… (after the great elements and the aggregates, the five bases and the physical base are to be worked out) because of the mutuality condition… because of the support condition… because of the non-disappearance condition. ^7-21-20

####### *Positive Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-16-0

####### *The Counting* ^7-2-1-1-15-17-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-21]]

Root: two, object… non-disappearance: two.
The positive method. ^7-21-21

####### *Negative Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-18-0

####### *The Exposition* ^7-2-1-1-15-19-0

######## *The Not-Root Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-19-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-22]]

With an internal state as condition, an internal state arises not because of the root condition – with one internal aggregate without roots as condition, three aggregates… at the moment of rebirth without roots… with the aggregates as condition, the physical base; with the physical base as condition, the aggregates. One great element… matter produced by nutriment… matter produced by temperature… of the non-percipient beings, one great element… the eye base… the body base… with the physical base as condition, the internal aggregates without roots. With the aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness and the physical base as condition, delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness. (1)
With an external state as condition, an external state arises not because of the root condition (both the course of life and rebirth, and also the great elements, are to be worked out) – the eye base… the body base… with the physical base as condition, the external aggregates without roots. With the aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness and the physical base as condition, delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness. (1) ^7-21-22

######## *The Not-Object Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-15-19-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-23]]

Not because of the object condition… not because of the predominance condition (the same as the co-arising)… not because of the proximity condition… not because of the contiguity condition… not because of the mutuality condition… not because of the strong-support condition… not because of the pre-arising condition (the same as the dependence section)… not because of the post-arising condition… not because of the repetition condition… not because of the kamma condition… not because of the dissociation condition (the same as dissociation in the negative method of the dependence section)… not because of the absence condition… not because of the disappearance condition…. ^7-21-23

####### *The Counting* ^7-2-1-1-15-21-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-24]]

Not-root: two, not-object: two… not-disappearance: two.
The negative method. ^7-21-24

####### *Positive-Negative Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-22-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-25]]

With root as condition – not-object: two, not-predominance: two… not-result, not-association, not-dissociation, not-absence, not-disappearance: two.
The positive-negative method. ^7-21-25

####### *Negative-Positive Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-23-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-26]]

With not-root as condition – object: two… non-disappearance: two.
The negative-positive method. ^7-21-26

######## *The Condition Section* ^7-2-1-1-15-23-1-0

######## *4-6. The Support, Conjoined and Association Sections* ^7-2-1-1-15-23-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-U318]]

(The support section is the same as the condition section. The conjoined section and the association section should also be expanded.) ^7-U318

####### *The Analysis Section* ^7-2-1-1-15-24-0

####### *Positive Method of the Conditions* ^7-2-1-1-15-25-0

####### *The Exposition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-0

######## *The Root Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-27]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of root condition – internal roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth…. (1)
An external state is a condition for an external state by way of root condition – external roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth…. (1) ^7-21-27

######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-28]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of object condition – having given a gift, having undertaken the precepts, having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews that; one reviews good deeds done earlier… having emerged from jhāna… having emerged from the noble path, noble ones review the path, review the fruit, review the defilements that have been abandoned, review the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements that occurred earlier. The internal eye… body… visible forms… tangible objects… the physical base… one sees the internal aggregates with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. One sees visible form with the divine eye, one hears sound with the divine ear element; the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The visible-form base… the tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for body-consciousness. Internal aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)
An internal state is a condition for an external state by way of object condition – another person, the internal eye… the physical base… sees the internal aggregates with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. One sees visible form with the divine eye, one hears sound with the divine ear element. With knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one who is possessed of an internal mind. The internal visible-form base is a condition for external eye-consciousness… the internal tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for external body-consciousness. Internal aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (2) ^7-21-28

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-29]]

An external state is a condition for an external state by way of object condition – another person, having given a gift, having undertaken the precepts, having carried out the observance-day duties, reviews that; reviews good deeds done earlier; having emerged from jhāna… having emerged from the noble path, noble ones review the path, review the fruit… review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting. Noble ones review the defilements that have been abandoned, review the defilements that have been suppressed, review those that occurred earlier… another person, the external eye… the physical base… sees the external aggregates with insight as impermanent… distress arises. One sees visible form with the divine eye, one hears sound with the divine ear element. With knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one who is possessed of an external mind… the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. The external visible-form base is a condition for external eye-consciousness… the external tangible base is a condition for external body-consciousness… external aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)
An external state is a condition for an internal state by way of object condition – noble ones review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit, and for adverting. The external eye… the physical base… the external aggregates, with insight as impermanent… distress arises. One sees visible form with the divine eye, one hears sound with the divine ear element. With knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one who is possessed of an external mind. The external visible-form base is a condition for internal eye-consciousness… the external tangible base is a condition for internal body-consciousness… external aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (2) ^7-21-29

######## *The Predominance Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-30]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – having given a gift, having undertaken the precepts, having carried out the observance-day duties, giving it weight, one reviews that; giving weight to good deeds done earlier… having emerged from jhāna, giving weight to the jhāna… having emerged from the noble path, giving weight to the path… giving weight to the fruit, noble ones review it. The internal eye… the physical base… giving weight to the internal aggregates, one enjoys and delights in them; giving weight to that, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – internal predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)
An internal state is a condition for an external state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – another person, the internal eye… the physical base… giving weight to the internal aggregates, enjoys and delights in them; giving weight to that, lust arises, wrong view arises. (2) ^7-21-30

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-31]]

An external state is a condition for an external state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – another person, having given a gift, having undertaken the precepts, having carried out the observance-day duties, giving it weight, reviews that; giving weight to good deeds done earlier… having emerged from jhāna… having emerged from the noble path, giving weight to the path… giving weight to the fruit… giving weight to nibbāna, noble ones review it. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, and for the fruit. The external eye… the physical base… giving weight to the external aggregates, one enjoys and delights in them; giving weight to that, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – external predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)
An external state is a condition for an internal state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – noble ones, giving weight to nibbāna, review it. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, and for the fruit. The external eye… the physical base… giving weight to the external aggregates, one enjoys and delights in them; giving weight to that, lust… wrong view arises. (2) ^7-21-31

######## *The Proximity Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-32]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of proximity condition – preceding internal aggregates are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following internal aggregates. Conformity is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for change-of-lineage, conformity for cleansing, change-of-lineage for the path, cleansing for the path, the path for the fruit, the fruit for the fruit, conformity for the attainment of fruition; and, for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception for the attainment of fruition. (1)
An external state is a condition for an external state by way of proximity condition (the difference is "preceding ones are external"; the going is just the same). (1) ^7-21-32

######## *The Contiguity Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-33]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of contiguity condition… (the same as the proximity condition)… by way of co-arising condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of support condition. ^7-21-33

######## *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-34]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on internal faith, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties… jhāna… insight… the path… higher knowledge… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on internal virtue… wisdom… lust… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… temperature… food… lodging, one gives a gift… produces an attainment, kills a living being… splits the monastic community. Internal faith… wisdom, lust… longing, bodily pleasure… bodily pain… lodging are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for internal faith… wisdom, for lust… longing, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (1)
An internal state is a condition for an external state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – another person, relying on internal faith, gives a gift… fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Another person, relying on internal virtue… lodging, gives a gift, kills a living being… splits the monastic community. Internal faith… lodging are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for external faith… for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (2) ^7-21-34

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-35]]

An external state is a condition for an external state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – another person, relying on external faith… longing, bodily pleasure… lodging, gives a gift… splits the monastic community; external faith… lodging are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for external faith… the attainment of fruition. (1)
An external state is a condition for an internal state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on external faith… lodging, one gives a gift… splits the monastic community. External faith… lodging are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for internal faith… the attainment of fruition. (2) ^7-21-35

######## *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-36]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the internal eye… the physical base, one sees with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… distress arises, one sees visible form with the divine eye, one hears sound with the divine ear element; the visible-form base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness. Pre-arising of the physical base – the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the internal aggregates. (1)
An internal state is a condition for an external state by way of pre-arising condition. Pre-arising object – another person, the internal eye… the physical base, sees with insight as impermanent… distress arises, sees visible form with the divine eye, hears sound with the divine ear element. The internal visible-form base is a condition for external eye-consciousness… the internal tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for external body-consciousness. (2) ^7-21-36

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-37]]

An external state is a condition for an external state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – another person, the external eye… the physical base, sees with insight as impermanent… sees visible form with the divine eye, hears sound with the divine ear element. The external visible-form base is a condition for external eye-consciousness… the external tangible base is a condition for external body-consciousness…. Pre-arising of the physical base – the external eye base… the body base… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the external aggregates. (1)
An external state is a condition for an internal state by way of pre-arising condition. Pre-arising object – the external eye… the physical base, sees with insight as impermanent… distress arises, sees visible form with the divine eye, hears sound with the divine ear element. The external visible-form base is a condition for internal eye-consciousness… the external tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for internal body-consciousness. (2) ^7-21-37

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-38]]

Internal and external states are a condition for an internal state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. The external visible-form base and the internal eye base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for internal eye-consciousness… the external tangible base and the internal body base for internal body-consciousness… the external visible-form base and the internal physical base… the external tangible base and the internal physical base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the internal aggregates. (1)
Internal and external states are a condition for an external state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. The internal visible-form base and the external eye base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for external eye-consciousness… the internal tangible base and the external body base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for external body-consciousness. The internal visible-form base and the external physical base… the internal tangible base and the external physical base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the external aggregates. (2) ^7-21-38

######## *The Post-arising Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-39]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of post-arising condition – post-arisen internal aggregates are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this body that arose earlier. (1)
An external state is a condition for an external state by way of post-arising condition – post-arisen external aggregates are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this body that arose earlier. (1) ^7-21-39

######## *The Repetition Condition* ^7-2-1-1-15-26-9-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-21-40]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of repetition condition – preceding internal aggregates are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following internal aggregates. Conformity is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing for the path. (1)

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-22-12]]

A state with an internal object is a condition for a state with an internal object by way of object condition – one reviews the internal base of infinite consciousness, reviews the base of neither perception nor non-perception; with an internal object, one reviews the internal divine eye, the divine ear element… knowledge of supernormal powers… knowledge of recollecting past lives… knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma… one reviews the knowledge of the future. Noble ones, with an internal object, review the defilements that have been abandoned, review the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements that occurred earlier. With an internal object, one sees the internal aggregates with insight as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust with an internal object arises… distress arises. Internal aggregates with an internal object are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)
A state with an internal object is a condition for a state with an external object by way of object condition – one reviews the external base of infinite consciousness, reviews the base of neither perception nor non-perception. With an internal object, one reviews the external divine eye, the divine ear element… knowledge of supernormal powers… knowledge of recollecting past lives… knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma… reviews the knowledge of the future; with an internal object, one sees the external aggregates with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… with knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one possessed of a consciousness that has an internal object and is external; external aggregates with an internal object are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (2) ^7-22-12

With an external object, one sees the external aggregates with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… with knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one possessed of a consciousness that has an external object and is external. External aggregates with an external object are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future, and for adverting. (1)

Having emerged from the noble path, noble ones review the path, review the fruit, review the defilements that have been abandoned with an external object, review the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements that occurred earlier. With an external object, one reviews the internal divine eye, the divine ear element… knowledge of supernormal powers… knowledge of others' minds… knowledge of recollecting past lives… knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma… knowledge of the future… with an external object, one sees the internal aggregates with insight as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust with an internal object arises… distress arises. A state with an external object is a condition for a state with an external object by way of repetition condition – preceding aggregates with an external object are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following aggregates with an external object. Conformity with an external object is a condition for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing for the path, by way of repetition condition. (1) ^7-22-21

Arising at different moments – volition with an internal object is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates with an internal object. (1)
A state with an internal object is a condition for a state with an external object by way of kamma condition. Arising at different moments – volition with an internal object is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates with an external object. (2)

Arising at different moments – volition with an external object is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates with an external object. (1)

External… produced by nutriment…, produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, dependent on one invisible and impinging great element, two great elements; dependent on two great elements, one great element….
(In the series based on the invisible and impinging state, all seven questions should be expanded by this method.) ^7-23-20

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-23-21]]

Dependent on an invisible and non-impinging state, an invisible and non-impinging state arises not because of the object condition – dependent on the invisible and non-impinging aggregates, invisible and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness. At the moment of rebirth, dependent on the invisible and non-impinging aggregates, invisible and non-impinging matter produced by kamma. Dependent on the aggregates, the physical base… dependent on the water element, invisible and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter. Dependent on the water element, the female faculty… physical food. External… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, dependent on the water element, invisible and non-impinging matter produced by kamma and derived matter.
(In the series based on the invisible and non-impinging state, all seven questions should be expanded by this method.) ^7-23-21

At the moment of rebirth, dependent on the invisible and non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, visible and impinging matter produced by kamma. Dependent on the invisible and impinging great elements and the water element, visible and impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter. Dependent on the tangible base and the water element, the visible-form base. External… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, dependent on the invisible and impinging great elements and the water element, visible and impinging matter produced by kamma and derived matter.

######## *The Not-Predominance Condition and the Rest* ^7-2-1-1-17-7-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-23-23]]

Dependent on an invisible and impinging state, an invisible and impinging state arises not because of the predominance condition (the same as the co-arising condition)… not because of the proximity condition… not because of the contiguity condition… not because of the mutuality condition – dependent on the invisible and impinging great elements, invisible and impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter. Dependent on the tangible base, the eye base… the taste base… external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, dependent on the great elements, invisible and impinging matter produced by kamma and derived matter.
(By this method twenty-one questions should be divided.)
Not because of the strong-support condition… not because of the pre-arising condition… not because of the post-arising condition… not because of the repetition condition… not because of the kamma condition – external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… dependent on one invisible and impinging great element, two great elements; dependent on two great elements, one great element. Dependent on the invisible and impinging great elements, invisible and impinging derived matter (having divided kamma, the twenty-one questions should be worked out with not-kamma alone), not because of the result condition (neither rebirth nor matter produced by kamma exists; it should be worked out only in the five-constituent existence), not because of the nutriment condition – external… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings… (by this method all twenty-one should be divided). ^7-23-23

Dependent on an invisible and non-impinging state, an invisible and non-impinging state arises not because of the jhāna condition – dependent on one aggregate accompanied by the five kinds of sense-consciousness, three aggregates… dependent on two aggregates… external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings, dependent on the water element, invisible and non-impinging matter produced by kamma and derived matter.

(All seven questions should be divided in this way), not because of the path condition… (it should be worked out the same as the not-root condition. Complete. There is no delusion). ######## *The Object Condition* ^7-2-1-1-17-15-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-23-30]]

A visible and impinging state is a condition for an invisible and non-impinging state by way of object condition – one sees visible forms with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, distress arises; with the divine eye one sees a visible form; the visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness. Visible and impinging aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
An invisible and impinging state is a condition for an invisible and non-impinging state by way of object condition. The eye… the body… sounds… odours… tastes… tangibles… as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine ear element one hears a sound; the sound base for ear-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… invisible and impinging aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-23-30

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-23-31]]

An invisible and non-impinging state is a condition for an invisible and non-impinging state by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna…; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, they review fruit, they review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, cleansing, the path, fruit and adverting. Noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before… the physical base… the female faculty… the male faculty… the life faculty… the water element… physical food… the invisible and non-impinging aggregates as impermanent… distress arises; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses invisible and non-impinging consciousness; the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness. The base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… invisible and non-impinging aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-23-31

Dependent on a state not a root, a state not a root arises not because of the nutriment condition – the external… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings…; not because of the faculty condition – the external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature…; among non-percipient beings, dependent on the great elements, the material life faculty; not because of the jhāna condition – the five kinds of sense-consciousness …; the external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings…; not because of the path condition – dependent on one aggregate without roots and not a root…; the external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… among non-percipient beings…; not because of the association condition… not because of the dissociation condition… (the same as the not-pre-arising condition, only the questions in the immaterial realm) not because of the absence condition… not because of the disappearance condition. ^7-24-13

###### 2-6 The Co-arising, Condition, Support, Conjoined and Association Sections ^7-3-1-1-13-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-U323]]

(The Co-arising Section, the Condition Section and the Support Section have just the same questions as the Dependence Section. When the great elements are finished, "with the physical base as condition" should be worked out. The five sense bases should be worked out as they are obtained, in the positive method and in the negative method. The Conjoined Section and the Association Section are also complete. There is no matter, only the immaterial.) ^7-U323

A root state and a state not a root are a condition for a state not a root by way of presence condition – co-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising – one aggregate not a root and roots are a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… at the moment of rebirth, roots and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for aggregates not roots. Co-arising – roots and great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by consciousness. Post-arising – roots and physical food are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body. Post-arising – roots and the material life faculty are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. (2)
A root state and a state not a root are a condition for a root state and a state not a root by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – one aggregate not a root and non-greed are a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates, non-hatred, non-delusion and matter produced by consciousness (the cycle). One aggregate not a root and greed are a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates, delusion and matter produced by consciousness (the cycle); at the moment of rebirth, one aggregate not a root and non-greed (the cycle). At the moment of rebirth… non-greed and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for non-hatred, non-delusion and the associated aggregates; greed and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for delusion and the associated aggregates….
A condition by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition. (3) ^7-24-41

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-1-62-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-24-98]]

A state with roots is a condition for a state with roots by way of object condition – having given a gift, the precepts… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews that; one reviews good deeds done earlier; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna. Having emerged from the noble path, noble ones review the path, review the fruit. The abandoned defilements… the suppressed defilements… earlier… one sees the aggregates with roots with insight as impermanent… distress arises; when the wholesome and unwholesome have ceased, a result with roots, registration, arises; with knowledge of others' minds, they know the mind of one endowed with a mind with roots. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… aggregates with roots are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, and for knowledge of the future; with the aggregates with roots as object, aggregates with roots arise. (1)
A state with roots is a condition for a state without roots by way of object condition – one sees the aggregates with roots with insight as impermanent… distress arises; when the wholesome and unwholesome have ceased, a result without roots, registration, arises; with the aggregates with roots as object, aggregates without roots and delusion arise. (2)
A state with roots is a condition for a state with roots and a state without roots by way of object condition – with the aggregates with roots as object, aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, and delusion, arise. (3) ^7-24-98

(1)
A state without roots is a condition for a state with roots by way of object condition – noble ones review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit. (2)
A state without roots is a condition for a state with roots and a state without roots by way of object condition – with the eye as object, aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, and delusion, arise; the ear… the physical base… with the aggregates without roots and delusion as object, aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, and delusion, arise. (3) ^7-24-99

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-1-116-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-24-176]]

A state not a root but with roots is a condition for a state not a root but with roots by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts… carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; the jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review fruit; abandoned defilements… suppressed defilements… those habitually indulged in before… one sees the aggregates not a root but with roots with insight as impermanent… distress arises; when the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result not a root but with roots arises as registration; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not a root but with roots; the base of infinite space… the base of nothingness… aggregates not a root but with roots are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future; with the aggregates not a root but with roots as object, aggregates not a root but with roots arise. (1)
A state not a root but with roots is a condition for a state not a root and without roots by way of object condition – one sees the aggregates not a root but with roots with insight as impermanent… distress arises; when the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result not a root and without roots arises as registration; with the aggregates not a root but with roots as object, aggregates not a root and without roots arise. (2) ^7-24-176

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-24-177]]

A state not a root and without roots is a condition for a state not a root and without roots by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for adverting; the eye… the physical base… one sees the aggregates not a root and without roots with insight as impermanent… distress arises; when the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result not a root and without roots arises as registration. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… with the aggregates not a root and without roots as object, aggregates not a root and without roots arise. (1)
A state not a root and without roots is a condition for a state not a root but with roots by way of object condition – noble ones review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path and for fruit; the eye… the physical base… one sees the aggregates not a root and without roots with insight as impermanent… distress arises; when the wholesome and the unwholesome have ceased, a result not a root but with roots arises as registration; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not a root and without roots. Aggregates not a root and without roots are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future; with the aggregates not a root and without roots as object, aggregates not a root but with roots arise. ####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-1-116-2-0

Giving weight to the aggregates not a root but with roots, one enjoys and delights in them; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. A state not a root and without roots is a condition for a state not a root but with roots by way of predominance condition.
