####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-2-8-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-9]]

A state with conditions is a condition for a state with conditions by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts, carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past…; having emerged from jhāna…; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, they review fruit; abandoned defilements… suppressed defilements… they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; the eye… the physical base… one sees the aggregates with conditions with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness with conditions; the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the aggregates with conditions are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
A state without conditions is a condition for a state with conditions by way of object condition – noble ones review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, cleansing, the path, fruit and adverting. (1) ^7-25-9

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-2-8-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-10]]

A state with conditions is a condition for a state with conditions by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – after giving a gift, the precepts… carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, giving it weight; good deeds done in the past…; having emerged from jhāna…; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, giving it weight; giving fruit weight… giving weight to the eye… the physical base… the aggregates with conditions, one enjoys and delights in them; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance with conditions is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)
A state without conditions is a condition for a state with conditions by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – noble ones review nibbāna, giving it weight; nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, cleansing, the path and fruit. (1) ^7-25-10

Co-arising predominance – invisible predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for invisible matter produced by consciousness. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible state by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – invisible predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for visible matter produced by consciousness. (2)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible and an invisible state by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – invisible predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for visible and invisible matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-25-36

####### *The Proximity Condition* ^7-3-1-2-38-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-37]]

An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of proximity condition – preceding invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following invisible aggregates; conformity for change-of-lineage… change-of-lineage for the path… the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for attainment of fruition. (1) ^7-25-37

####### *The Contiguity Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-2-38-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-38]]

An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of contiguity condition… by way of co-arising condition… three… by way of mutuality condition… one… by way of support condition… three. ^7-25-38

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-2-38-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-39]]

A visible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – longing for beauty of complexion, one gives a gift… the precepts… carries out the observance-day duties; beauty of complexion for faith… for longing… for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, for attainment of fruition is a condition by way of strong-support condition. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift… produces attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; the precepts… relying on lodging, one gives a gift… splits the monastic community; faith… lodging for faith… for attainment of fruition is a condition by way of strong-support condition. (1) ^7-25-39

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-2-38-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-40]]

A visible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of pre-arising condition – one sees visible matter with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye; the visible-form base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for eye-consciousness. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… the physical base, as impermanent… distress arises, one hears a sound with the divine ear element; the sound base for ear-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for body-consciousness. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for invisible aggregates. (1)
Visible and invisible states are a condition for an invisible state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. The visible-form base and the physical base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for invisible aggregates; the visible-form base and the eye base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for eye-consciousness. (1) ^7-25-40

####### *The Post-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-2-38-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-41]]

An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of post-arising condition – post-arising invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this invisible body that arose earlier. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible state by way of post-arising condition – post-arising invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this visible body that arose earlier. (2)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible and an invisible state by way of post-arising condition – post-arising invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this visible and invisible body that arose earlier. (3) ^7-25-41

####### *The Repetition Condition* ^7-3-1-2-38-9-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-42]]

An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of repetition condition – preceding invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following invisible aggregates… conformity for change-of-lineage… conformity for cleansing… change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing is a condition, by way of repetition condition, for the path. (1) ^7-25-42

####### *The Kamma Condition* ^7-3-1-2-38-10-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-43]]

An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment. Co-arising – invisible volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the associated aggregates and for invisible matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. From a different moment – invisible volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for resultant aggregates and for invisible matter produced by kamma. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible state by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment (to be expanded). (2)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible and an invisible state by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment (to be expanded). (3) ^7-25-43

####### *The Result Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-2-38-11-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-44]]

An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of result condition… three… by way of nutriment condition… three (in all three, physical food is to be worked out)… by way of faculty condition… three (in all three, the material life faculty)… by way of jhāna condition… three… by way of path condition… three… by way of association condition… one. ^7-25-44

####### *The Dissociation Condition* ^7-3-1-2-38-12-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-45]]

An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for invisible matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for invisible matter produced by kamma; the aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the physical base, and the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the aggregates. Pre-arising – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for invisible aggregates. Post-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for this invisible body that arose earlier. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible state by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for visible matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. Post-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for this visible body that arose earlier. (2)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible and an invisible state by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for visible and invisible matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. Post-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for this visible and invisible body that arose earlier. (3) ^7-25-45

####### *The Presence Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-2-38-13-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-46]]

A visible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of presence condition – one sees visible matter with insight as impermanent… distress arises, one sees a visible form with the divine eye; the visible-form base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for eye-consciousness. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for an invisible state by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising – one invisible aggregate is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for invisible matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates… (abbreviated. As far as the non-percipient beings). Pre-arising – the eye… the physical base, as impermanent… distress arises, one hears a sound with the divine ear element; the sound base for ear-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for invisible aggregates. Post-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this invisible body that arose earlier; physical food is a condition, by way of presence condition, for this invisible body; the material life faculty is a condition, by way of presence condition, for invisible matter produced by kamma. (1)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible state by way of presence condition – co-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of presence condition, for visible matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth… the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for visible matter produced by consciousness, for matter produced by kamma and for derived matter… external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… for non-percipient beings the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for visible matter produced by kamma and for derived matter. Post-arising – invisible aggregates are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this visible body that arose earlier; physical food is a condition, by way of presence condition, for this visible body; the material life faculty is a condition, by way of presence condition, for visible matter produced by kamma. (2)
An invisible state is a condition for a visible and an invisible state by way of presence condition – co-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising – one invisible aggregate is a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for visible and invisible matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for visible and invisible matter produced by consciousness, for matter produced by kamma and for derived matter; external… produced by nutriment… produced by temperature… for non-percipient beings the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for visible and invisible matter produced by kamma and for derived matter. (3) ^7-25-46

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-47]]

Visible and invisible states are a condition for an invisible state by way of presence condition. Pre-arising – the visible-form base and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for invisible aggregates; the visible-form base and the eye base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for eye-consciousness.
It is a condition by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition. ^7-25-47

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-53]]

Dependent on an impinging state, an impinging state arises because of the root condition – dependent on one impinging great element, two great elements; dependent on two great elements, one great element; dependent on the impinging great elements, impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the tangible base, the eye base… the taste base. (1)
Dependent on an impinging state, a non-impinging state arises because of the root condition – dependent on the impinging great elements, the water element; dependent on the impinging great elements, non-impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the tangible base, the water element, the female faculty… physical food. (2)
Dependent on an impinging state, impinging and non-impinging states arise because of the root condition – dependent on one impinging great element, two great elements and the water element; dependent on two great elements… dependent on the impinging great elements, impinging and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the tangible base, the eye base… the taste base, the water element, the female faculty… physical food. (3) ^7-25-53

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-54]]

Dependent on a non-impinging state, a non-impinging state arises because of the root condition – dependent on one non-impinging aggregate, three aggregates and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates; dependent on the water element, non-impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the water element, the female faculty… physical food. (1)
Dependent on a non-impinging state, an impinging state arises because of the root condition – dependent on the non-impinging aggregates, impinging matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth… dependent on the water element, the impinging great elements; dependent on the water element, impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the water element, the eye base… the tangible base. (2)
Dependent on a non-impinging state, impinging and non-impinging states arise because of the root condition – dependent on one non-impinging aggregate, three aggregates and impinging and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness… dependent on two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… dependent on the water element, impinging and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the water element, the eye base… the tangible base, the female faculty… physical food. (3) ^7-25-54

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-55]]

Dependent on an impinging and a non-impinging state, an impinging state arises because of the root condition – dependent on the non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, impinging matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth… dependent on one impinging great element and the water element, two great elements… dependent on the impinging great elements and the water element, impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the tangible base and the water element, the eye base…. (1)
Dependent on an impinging and a non-impinging state, a non-impinging state arises because of the root condition – dependent on the non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, non-impinging matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, dependent on the non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, non-impinging matter produced by kamma; dependent on the tangible base and the water element, non-impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the tangible base and the water element, the female faculty… physical food. Dependent on an impinging and a non-impinging state, impinging and non-impinging states arise because of the root condition – dependent on the non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, impinging and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth… dependent on the non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, impinging and non-impinging matter produced by kamma; dependent on the tangible base and the water element, impinging and non-impinging matter produced by consciousness, matter produced by kamma and derived matter; dependent on the tangible base and the water element, the eye base… the taste base, the female faculty… physical food. (3) ^7-25-55

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-2-67-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-69]]

An impinging state is a condition for a non-impinging state by way of object condition – the eye… tangible objects, one sees with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… impinging aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A non-impinging state is a condition for a non-impinging state by way of object condition – a gift… the precepts… carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, they review fruit, they review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, cleansing, the path, fruit and adverting; noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; the physical base… the female faculty… the male faculty… the life faculty… the water element, physical food, one sees with insight as impermanent… distress arises; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses non-impinging consciousness, the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… non-impinging aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-25-69

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-2-103-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-111]]

An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of root condition – immaterial roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
An immaterial state is a condition for a material state by way of root condition – immaterial roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (2)
An immaterial state is a condition for a material and an immaterial state by way of root condition – immaterial roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (3) ^7-25-111

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-2-103-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-112]]

A material state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of object condition – the eye… the physical base… the female faculty… the male faculty… the life faculty… the water element… physical food seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises, one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for body-consciousness; material aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-25-112

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-113]]

An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of object condition – after giving a gift… undertaking the precepts… carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruit, review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit, for adverting; noble ones review abandoned defilements… suppressed defilements… the past… immaterial aggregates seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises, by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses immaterial consciousness, the base of infinite space… for the base of neither perception nor non-perception…; immaterial aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-25-113

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-2-103-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-114]]

A material state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving weight to the eye… physical food, one enjoys and delights in it; giving weight to that, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)
An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving a gift… (abbreviated) nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the path and for the fruit; giving weight to the immaterial aggregates, one enjoys and delights in them… lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – immaterial predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
An immaterial state is a condition for a material state by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – immaterial predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
An immaterial state is a condition for a material and an immaterial state by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – immaterial predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-25-114

####### *The Proximity Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-2-103-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-115]]

An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of proximity condition – preceding immaterial aggregates are a condition for following immaterial aggregates… for the attainment of fruition, by way of proximity condition, by way of contiguity condition.
(In the co-arising condition, seven; here there is no combination. In the mutuality condition, six; in the support condition, seven questions; here there is no combination.) ^7-25-115

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-2-103-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-116]]

A material state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on temperature… food… lodging, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; temperature… food… lodging, for faith… for the attainment of fruition, are a condition by way of strong-support condition. (1)
An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift; relying on virtue… on bodily pain, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; faith… bodily pain… for faith… for the attainment of fruition, are a condition by way of strong-support condition. (1) ^7-25-116

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-2-103-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-117]]

A material state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… the physical base… physical food seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises. One sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness…. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for immaterial aggregates. (1) ^7-25-117

####### *The Post-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-2-103-7-0

####### *The Repetition Condition* ^7-3-1-2-103-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-119]]

An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of repetition condition – preceding immaterial aggregates are a condition, by way of repetition condition, for following immaterial aggregates. ^7-25-119

Arising at different moments – immaterial volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates. (1)

Co-arising – immaterial volition is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of nutriment condition… three. ^7-25-121

An immaterial state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of faculty condition… three.

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-124]]

A material state is a condition for an immaterial state by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising. ####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-2-141-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-149]]

A mundane state is a condition for a mundane state by way of object condition – after giving a gift… undertaking the precepts… carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna… noble ones review change-of-lineage, review cleansing, review abandoned defilements, review suppressed defilements… know the defilements habitually indulged in before; the eye… the physical base, the mundane aggregates seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses mundane consciousness; the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness; mundane aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-25-149

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-150]]

A supramundane state is a condition for a supramundane state by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path and for the fruit. (1)
A supramundane state is a condition for a mundane state by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruit, review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for adverting; by knowledge of others' minds noble ones know the consciousness of one who possesses supramundane consciousness; supramundane aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (2) ^7-25-150

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-2-141-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-151]]

A mundane state is a condition for a mundane state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – after giving a gift, virtue… the observance-day duties… the past… jhāna… trainees, giving weight to change-of-lineage, review it; giving weight to cleansing, they review it; the eye… the physical base, the mundane aggregates: giving weight to them, one enjoys and delights in them; giving weight to that, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – mundane predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (1) ^7-25-151

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-152]]

A supramundane state is a condition for a supramundane state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the path and for the fruit. Co-arising predominance – supramundane predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A supramundane state is a condition for a mundane state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path giving it weight, review the fruit giving it weight, review nibbāna giving it weight; nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage and for cleansing. Co-arising predominance – supramundane predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A supramundane state is a condition for a mundane and a supramundane state by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – supramundane predominance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-25-152

A mundane state is a condition for a supramundane state by way of proximity condition – change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing for the path… conformity for the attainment of fruition… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the attainment of fruition. (2) ^7-25-153

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-154]]

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-25-157]]

(1)

(2) ^7-25-157

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-3-25-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-16]]

A taint is a condition for a taint by way of root condition – the taint of sensual desire is a condition, by way of root condition, for the taints of wrong view and ignorance; the taint of becoming is a condition, by way of root condition, for the taint of ignorance (cycle). (1)
A taint is a condition for a state that is not a taint by way of root condition – the taints that are roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A taint is a condition for a taint and a state that is not a taint by way of root condition – the taint of sensual desire is a condition, by way of root condition, for the taints of wrong view and ignorance, the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-26-16

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-17]]

A state that is not a taint is a condition for a state that is not a taint by way of root condition – roots that are not taints are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state that is not a taint is a condition for a taint by way of root condition – roots that are not taints are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated taints. (2)
A state that is not a taint is a condition for a taint and a state that is not a taint by way of root condition – roots that are not taints are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, the taints and matter produced by consciousness. (3)
A taint and a state that is not a taint are a condition for a state that is not a taint by way of root condition – taints that are roots and roots that are not taints are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (1) ^7-26-17

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-3-25-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-18]]

A taint is a condition for a taint by way of object condition – with the taints as object, taints arise. (1)
A taint is a condition for a state that is not a taint by way of object condition – with the taints as object, aggregates that are not taints arise. (2)
A taint is a condition for a taint and a state that is not a taint by way of object condition – with the taints as object, taints and the associated aggregates arise. (3) ^7-26-18

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-19]]

A state that is not a taint is a condition for a state that is not a taint by way of object condition – a gift… virtue… the observance-day duties… good deeds done in the past… jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review fruit, review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for fruit and for adverting; noble ones know the abandoned defilements that are not taints… the suppressed defilements… the defilements they habitually indulged in before; the eye… the physical base, the aggregates that are not taints, as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees a visible form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound, by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness that is not a taint; the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the aggregates that are not taints are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A state that is not a taint is a condition for a taint by way of object condition – after giving a gift… one enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, taints arise; virtue… the observance-day duties… good deeds done in the past… jhāna… the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base, the aggregates that are not taints; with that as object, taints arise. (2)
A state that is not a taint is a condition for a taint and a state that is not a taint by way of object condition – after giving a gift… (second course) one enjoys and delights in the aggregates that are not taints; with that as object, taints and the associated aggregates arise. (3) ^7-26-19

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-20]]

A taint and a state that is not a taint are a condition for a taint by way of object condition – with the taints and the associated aggregates as object, taints arise. (1)
A taint and a state that is not a taint are a condition for a state that is not a taint by way of object condition – with the taints and the associated aggregates as object, aggregates that are not taints arise. (2)
A taint and a state that is not a taint are a condition for a taint and a state that is not a taint by way of object condition – with the taints and the associated aggregates as object, taints and the associated aggregates arise. (3) ^7-26-20

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-3-25-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-21]]

A taint is a condition for a taint by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving the taints weight, taints arise (three, the same as the object condition; those with objects given weight are to be worked out).
A state that is not a taint is a condition for a state that is not a taint by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – a gift… virtue… the observance-day duties… good deeds done in the past… jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path… fruit… nibbāna, giving it weight… nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path and for fruit; the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base, the aggregates that are not taints, giving them weight; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance that is not a taint is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (1)
A state that is not a taint is a condition for a taint by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – a gift… one enjoys and delights in the aggregates that are not taints, giving them weight; giving it weight, taints arise. Co-arising predominance – predominance that is not a taint is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated taints. (2)
A state that is not a taint is a condition for a taint and a state that is not a taint by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – a gift… one enjoys and delights in the aggregates that are not taints, giving them weight; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance that is not a taint is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates, the taints and matter produced by consciousness. (3)
A taint and a state that is not a taint are a condition for a taint by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving the taints and the associated aggregates weight, one enjoys and delights in them… taints arise (three, those with objects given weight). ^7-26-21

####### *The Proximity Condition* ^7-3-1-3-25-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-22]]

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-3-59-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-26-89]]

A state dissociated from the taints is a condition for a state dissociated from the taints by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – one sees the eye… the physical base with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for body-consciousness. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates dissociated from the taints and for delusion. (1)
A state dissociated from the taints is a condition for a state associated with the taints by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the aggregates associated with the taints. (2)
A state dissociated from the taints is a condition for a state associated with the taints and a state dissociated from the taints by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… with the physical base as object, aggregates accompanied by distress, accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness and delusion arise. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates accompanied by distress, accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness and for delusion. (3) ^7-26-89

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-5-66-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-69]]

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of root condition – roots associated with the ties are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of root condition – roots associated with the ties are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness; the root accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of root condition, for greed and for matter produced by consciousness; the root accompanied by distress is a condition, by way of root condition, for aversion and for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of root condition – roots associated with the ties are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; the root accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, for greed and for matter produced by consciousness; the root accompanied by distress is a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, for aversion and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-28-69

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-70]]

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of root condition – roots dissociated from the ties are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness; aversion is a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of root condition – greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; aversion is a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (2)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of root condition – greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; aversion is a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-28-70

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-71]]

A state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of root condition – the root accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; the root accompanied by distress and aversion are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of root condition – the root accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness; the root accompanied by distress and aversion are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of root condition – the root accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; the root accompanied by distress and aversion are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. ####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-5-66-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-72]]

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of object condition – with the aggregates associated with the ties as object, the aggregates associated with the ties arise. (The bases are to be asked in all three) With the aggregates associated with the ties as object, the aggregates dissociated from the ties arise; with the aggregates associated with the ties as object, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed arise, and the aggregates accompanied by distress and aversion arise. (3) ^7-28-72

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-73]]

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts… and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it; one reviews good deeds done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review fruit, review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for fruit and for adverting; noble ones review the abandoned defilements that are dissociated from the ties, review the suppressed defilements, know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; the eye… the physical base, the aggregates dissociated from the ties, greed and aversion: one sees them with insight as impermanent… sees with insight, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust dissociated from the ties arises, doubt… restlessness… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness dissociated from the ties; the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness…; the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception…; the visible-form base for eye-consciousness…; the tangible base for body-consciousness…; aggregates dissociated from the ties are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts…, carrying out the observance-day duties…, good deeds done in the past…, jhāna… one enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust associated with the ties arises… wrong view arises… distress arises (abbreviated). (2)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of object condition – the eye… the physical base; with the aggregates dissociated from the ties, greed and aversion as object, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by distress and aversion, arise. (3) ^7-28-73

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-74]]

A state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of object condition – with the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, greed, the aggregates accompanied by distress and aversion as object, the aggregates associated with the ties arise. (The base is to be asked) With the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, greed, the aggregates accompanied by distress and aversion as object, the aggregates dissociated from the ties arise; with the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, greed, the aggregates accompanied by distress and aversion as object, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed, and the aggregates accompanied by distress and aversion, arise. (3) ^7-28-74

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-5-66-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-75]]

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving weight to the aggregates associated with the ties, the aggregates associated with the ties arise. Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with the ties is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving weight to the aggregates associated with the ties, greed dissociated from wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with the ties is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness; predominance accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for greed and for matter produced by consciousness; predominance accompanied by distress is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for aversion and for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving weight to the aggregates associated with the ties, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed arise. Co-arising predominance – predominance accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates, for greed and for matter produced by consciousness; predominance accompanied by distress is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates, for aversion and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-28-75

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-76]]

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving… the precepts… the observance-day duties, giving it weight one reviews it; giving weight to good deeds done in the past, one reviews them; having emerged from jhāna, giving weight to the jhāna, one reviews it; noble ones, having emerged from the path, giving weight to the path, review it; having emerged from fruit, giving weight to the fruit, they review it; giving weight to nibbāna, they review it. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path and for fruit; the eye… the physical base; giving weight to the aggregates dissociated from the ties and to greed, one enjoys and delights in them; giving that weight, lust dissociated from the ties arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance dissociated from the ties is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving… the precepts… the observance-day duties… the past good deeds… having emerged from jhāna, the jhāna… the eye… the physical base; giving weight to the aggregates dissociated from the ties and to greed, one enjoys and delights in them; giving that weight, lust associated with the ties arises… wrong view arises. (2)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – the eye… the physical base; giving weight to the aggregates dissociated from the ties and to greed, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed arise. (3) ^7-28-76

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-77]]

A state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving weight to the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and to greed, the aggregates associated with the ties arise. (The bases are to be asked) Giving weight to the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and to greed, greed dissociated from wrong view arises. (The bases are to be asked) Giving weight to the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and to greed, the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and greed arise. (3) ^7-28-77

####### *The Proximity Condition* ^7-3-1-5-66-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-78]]

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates associated with the ties are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates associated with the ties. (The bases are to be asked) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following greed dissociated from wrong view; preceding aggregates accompanied by distress are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aversion; aggregates associated with the ties are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for emergence. (The bases are to be asked) Preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed; preceding aggregates accompanied by distress are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion. (1)

(2)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of proximity condition – preceding greed dissociated from wrong view is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed; preceding aversion is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion; adverting is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed, and for the aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion. (3) ^7-28-79

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-80]]

States associated with the ties and states dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view; preceding aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by distress. (The bases should be asked about.) preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following greed dissociated from wrong view; preceding aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aversion; aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, and aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for emergence. (The bases should be asked about.) preceding aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed; preceding aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion. ####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-5-66-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-82]]

A state associated with the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – aggregates associated with the ties are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for aggregates associated with the ties. (The base should be asked about; all three kinds of strong support.) aggregates associated with the ties are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for aggregates dissociated from the ties. (The base; all three kinds of strong support.) aggregates associated with the ties are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed; for aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion. (3) ^7-28-82

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-83]]

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift… produces an attainment… fosters conceit… relying on virtue… on wisdom… on lust… on hatred… on delusion… on conceit… on longing… on bodily pleasure… on bodily pain… on temperature… on food… on lodging, one gives a gift… produces an attainment… kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community; faith… wisdom, lust… longing… lodging for faith… for wisdom… for lust… for hatred… for delusion… for conceit… for longing… for the attainment of fruition is a condition, by way of strong-support condition. (1)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue… on wisdom… on lust… on conceit… on longing… on lodging, one kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community; faith… lodging for lust… for hatred… for delusion… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing is a condition, by way of strong-support condition. (2)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of strong-support condition (three kinds of strong support); relying on faith, one fosters conceit; relying on virtue… on wisdom… on lust… on hatred… on delusion… on conceit… on longing… on bodily pleasure… on lodging, one kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community; faith… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… longing… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed, and for aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion. (3) ^7-28-83

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-84]]

States associated with the ties and states dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, and aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for aggregates associated with the ties. (The base should be worked out.) aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, and aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for aggregates dissociated from the ties, for greed dissociated from wrong view and for aversion. (The base should be asked about.) aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, and aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed, and for aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion. (3) ^7-28-84

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-5-66-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-28-85]]

A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state dissociated from the ties by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… one sees the physical base with insight as impermanent, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust dissociated from the ties arises, doubt… restlessness… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness…. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates dissociated from the ties, and for greed dissociated from wrong view and for aversion. (1)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base; with that as object, lust associated with the ties arises, wrong view… distress arises. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates associated with the ties. (2)
A state dissociated from the ties is a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… with the physical base as object, aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, and aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, arise. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and for greed, and for aggregates accompanied by distress and for aversion. (3) ^7-28-85

Co-arising – aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by consciousness; aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for greed; aggregates accompanied by distress and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for aversion. Post-arising – aggregates accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, and aggregates accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body that arose earlier. Post-arising – aggregates associated with the ties and physical food are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body. Post-arising – aggregates associated with the ties and the material life faculty are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. (2)
States associated with the ties and states dissociated from the ties are a condition for a state associated with the ties and a state dissociated from the ties by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and greed, are a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates and…. Co-arising – one aggregate accompanied by distress, and aversion, are a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates and…. Co-arising – one aggregate accompanied by greed dissociated from wrong view, and the physical base, are a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for greed… two aggregates and…. Co-arising – one aggregate accompanied by distress, and the physical base, are a condition, by way of presence condition, for three aggregates and for aversion… two aggregates and…. (3) ^7-28-95

A hindrance is a condition for a hindrance and a state not a hindrance by way of root condition – hindrance roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, for hindrances and for matter produced by consciousness. (3)
A state not a hindrance is a condition for a state not a hindrance by way of root condition – roots not hindrances are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (1) ^7-30-25

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-7-28-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-30-26]]

A hindrance is a condition for a hindrance by way of object condition – with the hindrances as object, hindrances arise. (The base should be asked.) With the hindrances as object, aggregates not hindrances arise. (The base should be worked out.) With the hindrances as object, hindrances and the associated aggregates arise. (3) ^7-30-26

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-30-27]]

A state not a hindrance is a condition for a state not a hindrance by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, good deeds done in the past…, having emerged from jhāna, the jhāna…, noble ones, having emerged from the path, the path… the fruit… nibbāna… nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting; noble ones review the abandoned defilements not hindrances, the suppressed defilements… those habitually indulged in before… the eye… the physical base and the aggregates not hindrances as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees a visible form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not a hindrance, the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… aggregates not hindrances are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (1)
A state not a hindrance is a condition for a hindrance by way of object condition – giving… virtue… the observance-day duties… good deeds done in the past… jhāna… the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base and the aggregates not hindrances, with that as object, lust arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… distress arises. (2)
A state not a hindrance is a condition for a hindrance and a state not a hindrance by way of object condition – giving… virtue… the observance-day duties… good deeds done in the past… jhāna… the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base and the aggregates not hindrances, with that as object, hindrances and the associated aggregates arise. (3)
A hindrance and a state not a hindrance are a condition for a hindrance by way of object condition… three (to be worked out with 'as object'). ^7-30-27

Co-arising predominance – predominance not a hindrance is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-7-62-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-30-67]]

A state associated with the hindrances is a condition for a state associated with the hindrances by way of object condition – one enjoys and delights in lust, with that as object, lust arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… distress arises; one enjoys and delights in wrong view, with that as object, lust arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… distress arises; with doubt as object, doubt… wrong view… restlessness… distress arises; with restlessness as object, restlessness arises, wrong view… doubt, distress arises; with distress as object, distress arises; wrong view… doubt… restlessness arises. (1)
A state associated with the hindrances is a condition for a state dissociated from the hindrances by way of object condition – noble ones review the abandoned defilements associated with the hindrances, review the suppressed defilements, know the defilements habitually indulged in before; one sees the aggregates associated with the hindrances with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness associated with the hindrances; aggregates associated with the hindrances are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (2) ^7-30-67

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-30-68]]

A state dissociated from the hindrances is a condition for a state dissociated from the hindrances by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, good deeds done in the past…, having emerged from jhāna, the jhāna…, noble ones, having emerged from the path, the path… the fruit… nibbāna… nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting; the eye… one sees the physical base and the aggregates dissociated from the hindrances with insight as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self, with the divine eye one sees a visible form (as far as adverting). (1)
A state dissociated from the hindrances is a condition for a state associated with the hindrances by way of object condition – giving… virtue… the observance-day duties… in the past… jhāna… the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base and the aggregates dissociated from the hindrances, with that as object, lust arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… distress arises. (2) ^7-30-68

Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with the hindrances is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the aggregates associated with the hindrances. (1)
A state associated with the hindrances is a condition for a state dissociated from the hindrances by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with the hindrances is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (The base should be asked.) Predominance associated with the hindrances is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-30-69

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-30-70]]

Object-predominance – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, giving it weight, good deeds done in the past…, having emerged from jhāna, the jhāna…, noble ones, having emerged from the path, the path, giving it weight… the fruit… nibbāna… nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path and for the fruit. Co-arising predominance – predominance dissociated from the hindrances is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (1)
A state dissociated from the hindrances is a condition for a state associated with the hindrances by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving… virtue… in the past… jhāna… the eye… giving weight to the physical base and the aggregates dissociated from the hindrances, one enjoys and delights in them, giving weight to that, lust arises, wrong view arises. (2) ^7-30-70

A state dissociated from the hindrances is a condition for a state associated with the hindrances by way of proximity condition – adverting is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for aggregates associated with the hindrances. (2) ^7-30-71

Natural strong-support – relying on lust, one kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community; relying on hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing, one kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community; lust… longing is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for lust… for longing. (1)

(2) ^7-30-73

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-30-74]]

A state dissociated from the hindrances is a condition for a state dissociated from the hindrances by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. (1)
A state dissociated from the hindrances is a condition for a state associated with the hindrances by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. (1)
A state associated with wrong grasping is a condition for a state dissociated from wrong grasping by way of object condition – noble ones review the abandoned defilements associated with wrong grasping, they know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; one sees the aggregates associated with wrong grasping with insight as impermanent…, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, lust dissociated from wrong grasping… doubt… restlessness… distress arises; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses a consciousness associated with wrong grasping; the aggregates associated with wrong grasping are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses a consciousness dissociated from wrong grasping; the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the aggregates dissociated from wrong grasping are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
A state dissociated from wrong grasping is a condition for a state associated with wrong grasping by way of object condition – giving… virtue… the observance-day duties… good deeds done in the past… jhāna… the eye… one enjoys and delights in the physical base and the aggregates dissociated from wrong grasping.
