####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-9-30-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-27]]

A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of root condition – roots with an object are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state with an object is a condition for a state without an object by way of root condition – roots with an object are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (2)
A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object and a state without an object by way of root condition – roots with an object are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (3) ^7-32-27

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-9-30-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-28]]

A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises; good deeds done in the past… having emerged from jhāna, the jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruit, review the abandoned defilements… the suppressed defilements… know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; the aggregates with an object, seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness with an object; the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the aggregates with an object are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1) ^7-32-28

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-29]]

A state without an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of object condition – noble ones review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting; the eye… the physical base, seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the aggregates without an object are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1) ^7-32-29

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-9-30-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-30]]

A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, giving it weight, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises; good deeds done in the past… having emerged from jhāna, the jhāna… having emerged from the path, the path, giving it weight… the fruit, giving it weight… giving weight to the aggregates with an object, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance with an object is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state with an object is a condition for a state without an object by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance with an object is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object and a state without an object by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance with an object is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-32-30

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-31]]

A state without an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – noble ones review nibbāna, giving it weight; nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path and for the fruit; the eye… the physical base, giving it weight, one enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1) ^7-32-31

####### *The Proximity Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-30-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-32]]

A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates with an object… are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the attainment of fruition… by way of contiguity condition… one… by way of co-arising condition… seven (in the dependence section, the same as co-arising)… by way of mutuality condition… six (in the dependence section, the same as mutuality)… by way of support condition… seven (in the condition section, the same as support). ^7-32-32

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-9-30-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-33]]

A state with an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift… fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view. Relying on virtue… wisdom, lust… longing, bodily pleasure… bodily pain, one gives a gift… produces an attainment, kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community. Faith… wisdom, lust… longing, bodily pleasure… bodily pain are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… wisdom, for lust… longing, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path and for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A state without an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on climate, food and lodging, one gives a gift… produces an attainment, kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community. Climate… food… lodging are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… longing, for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path and for the attainment of fruition. (1) ^7-32-33

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-9-30-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-34]]

A state without an object is a condition for a state with an object by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness…. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the aggregates with an object. From a different moment – volition with an object is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates. (1)

Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting; noble ones review the abandoned defilements that are not consciousness, review the suppressed defilements, know the defilements they habitually indulged in before; the eye… the physical base, the aggregates that are not consciousness, seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses what is not consciousness; the base of infinite space… the base of nothingness… the visible-form base for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base for the aggregates accompanied by body-consciousness… the aggregates that are not consciousness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. With the aggregates that are mental factors as object, the aggregates that are mental factors and consciousness arise. (3) ^7-32-120

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-121]]

One sees a visible form with the divine eye, one hears a sound with the divine ear element. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness that is not a mental factor; the base of infinite space… the base of nothingness… the visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… the aggregates that are not mental factors are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. A state that is not a mental factor is a condition for a state that is a mental factor by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path… review nibbāna (the same as the first course); one sees the eye… the physical base, the aggregates that are not mental factors, with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, one hears a sound with the divine ear element. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness that is not a mental factor; the base of infinite space… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base for the aggregates accompanied by body-consciousness… the aggregates that are not mental factors are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of the future and adverting. (3) ^7-32-121

Object-predominance – giving weight to the aggregates that are mental factors, consciousness arises. A state that is a mental factor and a state that is not a mental factor are a condition for a state that is a mental factor and a state that is not a mental factor by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – one aggregate accompanied by eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates and for eye-consciousness… one aggregate accompanied by body-consciousness and the body base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates and for body-consciousness; two aggregates and…. Co-arising – one aggregate that is a mental factor and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates and for consciousness; two aggregates and… (two to be worked out at rebirth). (3) ^7-32-136

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-9-139-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-163]]

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of root condition – roots associated with consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state dissociated from consciousness by way of root condition – roots associated with consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (2)
A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness and a state dissociated from consciousness by way of root condition – roots associated with consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (3) ^7-32-163

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-9-139-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-164]]

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises; good deeds done earlier…; having emerged from jhāna, jhāna…; having emerged from the path, noble ones review the path, they review the fruit. They review abandoned defilements… they review suppressed defilements. They know defilements that occurred earlier. They see the aggregates associated with consciousness with insight as impermanent… distress arises. By knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one endowed with a state associated with consciousness. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the aggregates associated with consciousness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1) ^7-32-164

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-165]]

A state dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of object condition – noble ones review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting; the eye… the physical base; they see the aggregates dissociated from consciousness with insight as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees visible form, with the divine ear element one hears sound. The visible-form base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base… the aggregates dissociated from consciousness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1) ^7-32-165

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-9-139-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-166]]

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, giving it weight one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Earlier… jhāna… having emerged from the path, noble ones, giving it weight, review the path, giving it weight, review the fruit; giving weight to the aggregates associated with consciousness, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. (1)
A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state dissociated from consciousness by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness and a state dissociated from consciousness by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-32-166

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-167]]

A state dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – noble ones, giving it weight, review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path and for the fruit; the eye… the physical base, the aggregates dissociated from consciousness – giving them weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1) ^7-32-167

####### *The Proximity Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-139-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-168]]

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates associated with consciousness… for the attainment of fruition are a condition by way of proximity condition… by way of contiguity condition… by way of co-arising condition… seven (the same as the Dependence Section; there are no combinations of questions)… by way of mutuality condition… six (the same as the Dependence Section)… by way of support condition… seven (the same as the Condition Section; there are no combinations of questions). ^7-32-168

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-9-139-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-169]]

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift… fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue… longing, bodily pleasure… bodily pain, one gives a gift… kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community; faith… bodily pain is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A state dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on temperature… food… lodging, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; temperature… food… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for the attainment of fruition. (1) ^7-32-169

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-9-139-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-170]]

A state dissociated from consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… the physical base as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees visible form, with the divine ear element one hears sound. The visible-form base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base…. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the body base…; the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the aggregates associated with consciousness. (1) ^7-32-170

####### *The Post-arising and Repetition Conditions* ^7-3-1-9-139-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-171]]

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state dissociated from consciousness by way of post-arising condition (abbreviated), one; by way of repetition condition… one. ^7-32-171

####### *The Kamma Condition* ^7-3-1-9-139-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-172]]

A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment. Co-arising – volition associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth…. Arising at different moments – volition associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates. (1)
A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state dissociated from consciousness by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment. Co-arising – volition associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. Arising at different moments – volition associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for matter produced by kamma. (2)
A state associated with consciousness is a condition for a state associated with consciousness and a state dissociated from consciousness by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment. Co-arising – volition associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. Arising at different moments – volition associated with consciousness is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates and for matter produced by kamma. (3) ^7-32-172

A state associated with consciousness and a state dissociated from consciousness are a condition for a state associated with consciousness by way of faculty condition – the eye faculty and the faculty of equanimity are a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the body faculty and the faculty of pleasure… the body faculty and the faculty of pain are a condition, by way of faculty condition, for the aggregates accompanied by body-consciousness. ####### *The Not-Root Condition* ^7-3-1-9-168-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-206]]

With a state produced by consciousness as condition, a state produced by consciousness arises not because of the root condition. ###### The Conjoined Section ^7-3-1-9-172-0

####### *1-4. Positive Method of the Conditions and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-172-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-208]]

Conjoined with a state produced by consciousness, a state produced by consciousness arises because of the root condition – conjoined with one aggregate produced by consciousness, two aggregates; conjoined with two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
Conjoined with a state produced by consciousness, a state not produced by consciousness arises because of the root condition – conjoined with the aggregates produced by consciousness, consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (2)
Conjoined with a state produced by consciousness, states produced by consciousness and states not produced by consciousness arise because of the root condition – conjoined with one aggregate produced by consciousness, two aggregates and consciousness; conjoined with two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth…. (3) ^7-32-208

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-209]]

Conjoined with a state not produced by consciousness, a state produced by consciousness arises because of the root condition – the associated aggregates conjoined with consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
Conjoined with a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness, a state produced by consciousness arises because of the root condition – conjoined with one aggregate produced by consciousness and consciousness, two aggregates; conjoined with two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… (abbreviated). (1)
Root: five, object: five (five in every case), non-disappearance: five.
Conjoined with a state produced by consciousness, a state produced by consciousness arises not because of the root condition (five questions are to be worked out. Three. Delusion).
Not-root: five, not-predominance: five, not-pre-arising: five, not-post-arising: five, not-repetition: five, not-kamma: three, not-result: five, not-jhāna: five, not-path: five, not-dissociation: five. ^7-32-209

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-9-176-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-210]]

A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of root condition – roots produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not produced by consciousness by way of root condition – roots produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, roots produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for consciousness and for matter produced by kamma. (2)
A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of root condition – roots produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, for consciousness and for matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (3) ^7-32-210

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-9-176-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-211]]

A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of object condition – with the aggregates produced by consciousness as object, aggregates produced by consciousness arise. (The base is to be worked out.) With the aggregates produced by consciousness as object, consciousness arises. (The base is to be worked out.) With the aggregates produced by consciousness as object, aggregates produced by consciousness and consciousness arise. (3) ^7-32-211

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-212]]

A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not produced by consciousness by way of object condition – having emerged from the path, noble ones review the path, the fruit… they review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting; the eye… the physical base, the aggregates not produced by consciousness – one sees them with insight as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, consciousness arises. With the divine eye one sees visible form, with the divine ear element one hears sound. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one endowed with consciousness not produced by consciousness; the base of infinite space… the base of nothingness… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base… the aggregates not produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path… review nibbāna (the same as the first pass); the eye… the physical base, the aggregates not produced by consciousness – they see them with insight as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees visible form… The visible-form base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base… the aggregates not produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (2)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path… review nibbāna (the same as the first pass); one sees the aggregates not produced by consciousness with insight as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, consciousness and the associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye one sees visible form, with the divine ear element one hears sound. The visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates… the tangible base… the aggregates not produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (3)
A state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness are a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of object condition… three (to be worked out in the form “with that as object”). ^7-32-212

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-9-176-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-213]]

A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving weight to the aggregates produced by consciousness, aggregates produced by consciousness arise. Co-arising predominance – predominance produced by consciousness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness (all three are to be worked out, both object-predominance and co-arising predominance). (3)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance – noble ones, having emerged from the path… giving nibbāna weight… giving weight to the aggregates not produced by consciousness, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, consciousness arises. (1)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – noble ones, having emerged from the path… giving nibbāna weight, review it… giving weight to the aggregates not produced by consciousness, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance not produced by consciousness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – noble ones, having emerged from the path… giving nibbāna weight, review it… giving weight to the aggregates not produced by consciousness… consciousness and the associated aggregates arise. (3)
A state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness are a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance… three (only object-predominance). ^7-32-213

####### *The Proximity and Contiguity Conditions* ^7-3-1-9-176-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-214]]

A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of proximity condition… three (there is no emergence).
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not produced by consciousness by way of proximity condition – each preceding consciousness for each following one… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the attainment of fruition (the other two countings are to be worked out in exactly the same way as this).
A state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness are a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of proximity condition (three are to be worked out; there is no emergence)… by way of contiguity condition. ^7-32-214

####### *The Co-arising Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-176-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-215]]

A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of co-arising condition (the same as the Dependence Section)… by way of mutuality condition (the same as the Dependence Section)… by way of support condition (the same as the Condition Section). ^7-32-215

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-9-176-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-216]]

A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – (three questions are to be worked out). (3)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not produced by consciousness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on temperature… food… lodging and consciousness, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; temperature… food… lodging and consciousness are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for consciousness. (1)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on temperature… food… lodging and consciousness, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; temperature… food… lodging and consciousness are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (2)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on temperature… food… lodging and consciousness, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; temperature… food… lodging and consciousness are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the aggregates produced by consciousness and for consciousness. (3)
A state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness are a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support… three. ^7-32-216

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-9-176-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-217]]

A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of pre-arising condition. Pre-arising object – visible forms produced by consciousness… tangible objects as impermanent… one sees with insight… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees visible form, with the divine ear element one hears sound. The visible-form base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the aggregates accompanied by body-consciousness. A state produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of pre-arising condition. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base…; the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for consciousness. (1)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… the physical base as impermanent… distress arises. With the divine eye one sees visible form, with the divine ear element one hears sound. The visible-form base is a condition for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base…. (2)
A state not produced by consciousness is a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates… the body base…; the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for consciousness and the associated aggregates. ![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-219]]

(1)

(2)
A state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness are a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Co-arising – the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for eye-consciousness… the aggregates accompanied by body-consciousness…. Co-arising – those produced by consciousness… (the same as the Condition Section; both rebirth and the course of life are to be worked out for all the questions.) Post-arising – aggregates produced by consciousness and consciousness are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body not produced by consciousness that arose earlier. Post-arising – aggregates produced by consciousness, consciousness and physical food are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body not produced by consciousness. Post-arising – aggregates produced by consciousness, consciousness and the material life faculty are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. (2)
A state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness are a condition for a state produced by consciousness and a state not produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising. Co-arising – that accompanied by eye-consciousness… (abbreviated). (3)
It is a condition by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition… by way of non-disappearance condition. ^7-32-231

(3) ^7-32-292

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-9-247-1-0

A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of root condition – roots conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth…. (The base should be worked out.) Roots conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for consciousness and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (The base should be worked out.) Roots conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, consciousness and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (3) ^7-32-300

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-9-247-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-301]]

A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of object condition – with the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness as object, aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness arise. (The base should be worked out.) With the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness as object, consciousness arises. (The base should be worked out.) With the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness as object, consciousness and the associated aggregates arise. (3)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path… review nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage…. (Abbreviated. It is to be worked out in the same way as the object condition in the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair, without difference. All nine questions.) ^7-32-301

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-9-247-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-302]]

A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance… three (the two predominances are to be worked out). (3)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance… three (the two predominances are to be worked out). (3)
States conjoined with and produced by consciousness and states not conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of predominance condition – object-predominance. (Only one predominance is to be worked out, all nine questions. It is to be worked out in the same way as the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair, without difference.) ^7-32-302

####### *The Proximity Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-247-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-303]]

A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of proximity condition (all nine questions are the same as the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair)… by way of contiguity condition… nine… by way of co-arising condition… nine (the same as the Dependence Section)… by way of mutuality condition… nine (the same as the Dependence Section)… by way of support condition… nine (the same as the Condition Section)… by way of strong-support condition (all nine questions are the same as the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair, without difference). ^7-32-303

####### *The Pre-arising Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-247-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-304]]

A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base… three (the same as the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair, without difference).
A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of post-arising condition (the same as the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair, without difference. All three are post-arising. Two. For those with one base, one combination)… by way of repetition condition… nine. ^7-32-304

####### *The Kamma Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-247-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-305]]

A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of kamma condition… three (the same as the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair, without difference. All three are co-arising and from a different moment)… by way of result condition… nine… by way of nutriment condition… nine (the same as the course for the Coexisting-with-Consciousness Pair, with physical food as the only nutriment)… by way of faculty condition… nine… by way of jhāna condition… three… by way of path condition… three… by way of association condition… five. ^7-32-305

####### *The Dissociation Condition* ^7-3-1-9-247-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-306]]

A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (1)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). (1)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – at the moment of rebirth, the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness. Pre-arising – the eye base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the body base… the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness. (2)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness and a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – at the moment of rebirth, the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for consciousness and the associated aggregates. Pre-arising – the eye base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates… the body base… the physical base is a condition, by way of dissociation condition, for consciousness and the associated aggregates. (3)
States conjoined with and produced by consciousness and states not conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of dissociation condition – co-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). ^7-32-306

####### *The Presence Condition* ^7-3-1-9-247-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-307]]

A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition (the same as the Dependence Section). A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, post-arising (abbreviated). A state conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness and a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition (the same as the Dependence Section). (3)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty (the pre-arising is to be worked out in the same way as pre-arising. Everything is abbreviated. It should be expanded). (1)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – consciousness is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth, consciousness is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the associated aggregates, and at the moment of rebirth the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness. Pre-arising (the same as pre-arising, without difference). (2)
A state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness is a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness and a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – consciousness is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, consciousness is a condition, by way of presence condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by kamma, and at the moment of rebirth the physical base is a condition, by way of presence condition, for consciousness and the associated aggregates. Pre-arising (the same as pre-arising). (3) ^7-32-307

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-308]]

States conjoined with and produced by consciousness and states not conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – one aggregate accompanied by eye-consciousness and eye-consciousness are a condition for two aggregates… two aggregates and… one aggregate accompanied by eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition for two aggregates… two aggregates and… one aggregate accompanied by body-consciousness… one aggregate conjoined with and produced by consciousness and consciousness are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates; two aggregates and… one aggregate conjoined with and produced by consciousness and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates… two aggregates and… (at the moment of rebirth, the two are to be worked out). (1)
States conjoined with and produced by consciousness and states not conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition for a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising, post-arising, nutriment, faculty. Co-arising – the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for eye-consciousness… the aggregates accompanied by body-consciousness… the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness and consciousness are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter conjoined with and produced by consciousness, the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness and the great elements are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter conjoined with and produced by consciousness, the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for consciousness (at the moment of rebirth, all three are to be worked out). Post-arising – the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness and consciousness are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body not conjoined with and produced by consciousness that arose earlier. Post-arising – the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness, consciousness and physical food are a condition, by way of presence condition, for this body not conjoined with and produced by consciousness. Post-arising – the aggregates conjoined with and produced by consciousness, consciousness and the material life faculty are a condition, by way of presence condition, for matter produced by kamma. (2)
States conjoined with and produced by consciousness and states not conjoined with and produced by consciousness are a condition for a state conjoined with and produced by consciousness and a state not conjoined with and produced by consciousness by way of presence condition – co-arising, pre-arising. Co-arising – one aggregate accompanied by eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates and eye-consciousness, two aggregates and… one aggregate accompanied by body-consciousness…. Co-arising – one aggregate conjoined with and produced by consciousness and consciousness are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates and matter produced by consciousness, two aggregates and… one aggregate conjoined with and produced by consciousness and the physical base are a condition, by way of presence condition, for two aggregates and consciousness, two aggregates and… (at the moment of rebirth, the two are to be worked out). (3) ^7-32-308

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-9-282-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-340]]

An external state is a condition for an external state by way of root condition – external roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness – at the moment of rebirth, external roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and external matter produced by kamma. (1)
An external state is a condition for an internal state by way of root condition – external roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, external roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for consciousness and internal matter produced by kamma. (2)
An external state is a condition for an internal state and an external state by way of root condition – external roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, consciousness and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth, external roots are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates, consciousness and internal and external matter produced by kamma. (3) ^7-32-340

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-9-282-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-341]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of object condition – with consciousness as object, consciousness arises. (The base is to be asked.) With consciousness as object, the external aggregates arise. (The base is to be asked.) With consciousness as object, consciousness and the associated aggregates arise. (3)
An external state is a condition for an external state by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust… distress arises; one reviews good deeds done in the past, having emerged from jhāna, the jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path, the path… the fruit… review nibbāna… Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting. Noble ones review the abandoned external defilements, the suppressed defilements… know the defilements they habitually indulged in before, visible forms… the physical base, the external aggregates, seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees visible form, with the divine ear element one hears sound. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses external consciousness, the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the aggregates accompanied by eye-consciousness… the tangible base…; the external aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
An external state is a condition for an internal state by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, consciousness arises. Good deeds done in the past… the jhāna… (abbreviated, everything is to be worked out) the defilements they habitually indulged in before… visible forms… the physical base, the external aggregates as impermanent… one sees with insight, enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, consciousness arises. With the divine eye one sees visible form… the visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the tangible base…; the external aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (3)
An external state is a condition for an internal state and an external state by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, consciousness and the associated aggregates arise (abbreviated, everything is to be worked out). One sees the external aggregates with insight as impermanent… enjoys and delights in them; with that as object, consciousness and the associated aggregates arise. With the divine eye one sees visible form… the visible-form base is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness and the associated aggregates… the tangible base…; the external aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (3)
An internal state and an external state are a condition for an internal state by way of object condition… three. ^7-32-341

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-9-282-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-342]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – giving consciousness weight, consciousness arises. (1)
An internal state is a condition for an external state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving consciousness weight, the external aggregates arise. Co-arising predominance – predominance of consciousness is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (The base.) Object-predominance – giving internal consciousness weight, consciousness and the associated aggregates arise. (3)
An external state is a condition for an external state by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – having given a gift… three (the two predominances are to be worked out for all three). (3)
An internal state and an external state are a condition for an internal state by way of predominance condition… three (for all three, only one predominance). ^7-32-342

####### *The Proximity Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-282-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-343]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of proximity condition – each preceding consciousness is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for each following consciousness… three.
An external state is a condition for an external state by way of proximity condition – each preceding external aggregate is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for each following aggregate; conformity for change-of-lineage… three (all three alike).
An internal state and an external state are a condition for an internal state by way of proximity condition… three, by way of contiguity condition… nine, by way of co-arising condition… nine (the same as the Dependence Section), by way of mutuality condition… five (the same as the Dependence Section), by way of support condition… nine (the same as the Condition Section). ^7-32-343

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-9-282-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-344]]

An internal state is a condition for an internal state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – consciousness is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for consciousness… three.
An external state is a condition for an external state by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift… fosters conceit, takes up wrong view; virtue… relying on lodging, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; faith… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for the attainment of fruition (all three are to be completed and worked out; 'for consciousness' is to be worked out, and 'for the associated aggregates' is to be worked out).
An internal state and an external state are a condition for an internal state by way of strong-support condition… three. ^7-32-344

####### *The Post-arising and Repetition Conditions* ^7-3-1-9-282-7-0

###### The Exposition ^7-3-1-9-315-0

####### *The Root Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-394]]

A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of root condition – roots that are not derived are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and not-derived matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (1)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a derived state by way of root condition – roots that are not derived are a condition, by way of root condition, for derived matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (2)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a derived state and a state that is not derived by way of root condition – roots that are not derived are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and derived and not-derived matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (3) ^7-32-394

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-395]]

A derived state is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of object condition – the eye… the body… visible forms… tastes, one sees the physical base with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the taste base is a condition, by way of object condition, for tongue-consciousness; derived aggregates are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises; earlier… having emerged from jhāna, jhāna… having emerged from the path, noble ones review the path, the fruit… nibbāna… Nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit and for adverting. Noble ones review abandoned defilements, they review suppressed defilements… earlier… they see the tangible base and the aggregates that are not derived with insight as impermanent… distress arises; by knowledge of others' minds they know the consciousness of one endowed with a state that is not derived; the base of infinite space for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the tangible base is a condition, by way of object condition, for body-consciousness; aggregates that are not derived are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1) ^7-32-395

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-396]]

A derived state is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – the eye… the body… visible forms… tastes, the physical base, giving it weight, one enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, giving it weight one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Good deeds done earlier… having emerged from jhāna, jhāna… having emerged from the path, giving the path weight… the fruit… giving nibbāna weight, they review it. Nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for the fruit; giving weight to the tangible base and the aggregates that are not derived, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance that is not derived is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and not-derived matter produced by consciousness. (1)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a derived state by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance that is not derived is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for derived matter produced by consciousness. (2)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a derived state and a state that is not derived by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance that is not derived is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and derived and not-derived matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-32-396

####### *The Proximity Condition and the Rest* ^7-3-1-9-315-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-397]]

A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates that are not derived are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates that are not derived; conformity for change-of-lineage… is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for attainment of fruition. (1)
A condition by way of contiguity condition… by way of co-arising condition (the same as the Dependence Section)… by way of mutuality condition (the same as the Dependence Section)… by way of support condition (the same as the support condition in the Condition Section). ^7-32-397

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-398]]

A derived state is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on excellence of the eye… the body… excellence of complexion… excellence of sound… excellence of odour… excellence of taste… food, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community. Excellence of the eye… the body… excellence of complexion… excellence of sound… excellence of odour… excellence of taste… food is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith, one gives a gift… produces an attainment, nurtures conceit, takes up wrong view; virtue… wisdom… lust… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… relying on lodging, one gives a gift… causes a split in the monastic community; faith… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith… for the attainment of fruition. (1) ^7-32-398

####### *The Pre-arising Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-6-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-399]]

A derived state is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… one sees the physical base with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. The visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the taste base for tongue-consciousness…. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the aggregates that are not derived. (1)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of pre-arising condition. Pre-arising object – one sees tangible objects with insight as impermanent… distress arises; the tangible base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for body-consciousness. (1)
A derived state and a state that is not derived are a condition for a state that is not derived by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. The tangible base and the body base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for body-consciousness; the tangible base and the physical base are a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for the aggregates that are not derived. (1) ^7-32-399

####### *The Post-arising and Repetition Conditions* ^7-3-1-9-315-7-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-400]]

A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of post-arising condition – post-arising aggregates that are not derived are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this not-derived body that arose earlier. (The base should be asked) post-arising aggregates that are not derived are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this derived body that arose earlier. (The base should be asked) post-arising aggregates that are not derived are a condition, by way of post-arising condition, for this derived and not-derived body that arose earlier. (3)
A condition by way of repetition condition… one. ^7-32-400

####### *The Kamma Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-8-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-401]]

A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment. Co-arising – volition that is not derived is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the associated aggregates and not-derived matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. From a different moment – volition that is not derived is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates and not-derived matter produced by kamma. (1)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a derived state by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment. Co-arising – volition that is not derived is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for derived matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. From a different moment – volition that is not derived is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for derived matter produced by kamma. (2)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a derived state and a state that is not derived by way of kamma condition – co-arising, from a different moment. Co-arising – volition that is not derived is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the associated aggregates and derived and not-derived matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. From a different moment – volition that is not derived is a condition, by way of kamma condition, for the resultant aggregates and derived and not-derived matter produced by kamma. (3) ^7-32-401

####### *The Result Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-9-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-402]]

A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of result condition – one resultant aggregate that is not derived is a condition for three aggregates… two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth… three. ^7-32-402

####### *The Nutriment Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-10-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-403]]

A derived state is a condition for a derived state by way of nutriment condition – physical food is a condition, by way of nutriment condition, for this derived body. (The base should be asked) physical food is a condition, by way of nutriment condition, for this not-derived body. (The base should be asked) physical food is a condition, by way of nutriment condition, for this derived and not-derived body. (3)
A state that is not derived is a condition for a state that is not derived by way of nutriment condition – nutriments that are not derived are a condition, by way of nutriment condition, for the associated aggregates and not-derived matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth… (three in the series based on a state that is not derived; all three should be worked out at the moment of rebirth). (3) ^7-32-403

####### *The Faculty Condition* ^7-3-1-9-315-11-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-32-404]]

A derived state is a condition for a derived state by way of faculty condition – the material life faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for derived matter produced by kamma. (The base should be worked out) the eye faculty for eye-consciousness… the body faculty for body-consciousness, the material life faculty is a condition, by way of faculty condition, for not-derived matter produced by kamma. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one endowed with consciousness clung-to; the aggregates clung-to are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (2) ^7-32-446

Noble ones review abandoned defilements… suppressed defilements… earlier…; visible forms not clung-to… sounds… odours… tastes… tangibles, the aggregates not clung-to, seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees a visible form not clung-to, with the divine ear element one hears a sound. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one endowed with consciousness not clung-to; the base of infinite space…; the base of nothingness…; the aggregates not clung-to are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
A state not clung-to is a condition for a state clung-to by way of object condition – visible forms not clung-to… sounds… odours… tastes… tangibles, the aggregates not clung-to, seen with insight as impermanent… distress arises; when wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, a result arises as registration; the wholesome state of the base of infinite space is a condition for the resultant state of the base of infinite consciousness… the wholesome state of the base of nothingness…; the visible-form base not clung-to is a condition, by way of object condition, for eye-consciousness… the sound base…; the tangible base for body-consciousness. A state that is a clinging is a condition for a state that is a clinging by way of object condition – with clingings as object, clingings arise… three (to be worked out with 'as object').
A state that is not a clinging is a condition for a state that is not a clinging by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts… and carrying out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, and enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises; doubt… restlessness… distress arises; one reviews good deeds done in the past…; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna; noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, fruit… review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for the path, for fruit and for adverting. Noble ones review the abandoned defilements that are not clingings… the suppressed defilements, the defilements that occurred before…; the eye… the physical base and the aggregates that are not clingings, one sees with insight as impermanent… distress arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element. By knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness that is not a clinging; the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness…; the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception…; the visible-form base for eye-consciousness…; the tangible base for body-consciousness…; aggregates that are not clingings are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)

###### 1-6. The Dependence Section and the Rest ^7-4-1-1-121-0

####### *1-4. The Positive Method of the Conditions and the Rest* ^7-4-1-1-121-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-35]]

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises because of the root condition (it should be expanded in the same way as the Pair to Be Abandoned by Seeing, with no difference).
Root: five… non-disappearance: five.
The positive method.
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by development, a state to be abandoned by development arises not because of the root condition – dependent on the aggregates accompanied by restlessness, delusion accompanied by restlessness.
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by development, a state not to be abandoned by development arises not because of the root condition – dependent on one aggregate without roots not to be abandoned by development… (up to the non-percipient beings) dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt, delusion accompanied by doubt (abbreviated).
Not-root: two… not-disappearance: three.
The negative method.
(In the negative method of the condition section, under the not-root condition, three for those accompanied by restlessness; delusion should be extracted. All the sections are the same as the Pair to Be Abandoned by Seeing; the negative method regarding restlessness is also different.) ^7-35-35

Dependent on a state accompanied by happiness, a state not accompanied by happiness arises because of the root condition – dependent on the aggregates accompanied by happiness, happiness and matter produced by consciousness. (In this way the pair accompanied by happiness should be expanded, as in the positive Dependence Section of the pair with rapture.)

Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by happiness and without roots, happiness and matter produced by consciousness. Dependent on a state accompanied by happiness, a state accompanied by happiness and a state not accompanied by happiness arise not because of the root condition – dependent on one aggregate accompanied by happiness and without roots, two aggregates, happiness and matter produced by consciousness, two aggregates…. (3)
Dependent on a state not accompanied by happiness, a state not accompanied by happiness arises not because of the root condition – dependent on one aggregate not accompanied by happiness and without roots, three aggregates and matter produced by consciousness… two aggregates… dependent on happiness without roots, matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth without roots, dependent on one aggregate not accompanied by happiness, three aggregates and matter produced by kamma… two aggregates… dependent on the aggregates, the physical base; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates; one great element…. (As far as non-percipient beings) dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness. In the Condition Section, both the course of life and rebirth should be expanded; as in the negative Condition Section of the pair with rapture, in the course of life the physical base should also be expanded; as in the pair with rapture there is only one delusion; in the same way, the other two counts, the Support Section, the Conjoined Section and the Association Section should be done as in the pair with rapture.) ^7-35-169
