Death-consciousness accompanied by happiness for rebirth-consciousness not accompanied by happiness… life-continuum accompanied by happiness for adverting… body-consciousness accompanied by happiness for the resultant mind element… the resultant mind-consciousness element accompanied by happiness for the functional mind-consciousness element… life-continuum accompanied by happiness for life-continuum not accompanied by happiness… the wholesome and unwholesome accompanied by happiness for emergence not accompanied by happiness… the functional for emergence… fruit is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for emergence. ####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-4-1-1-217-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-173]]

A state accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of strong-support condition… three.
A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state not accompanied by happiness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith not accompanied by happiness, with consciousness not accompanied by happiness one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue not accompanied by happiness… on wisdom… on lust… on longing… on bodily pleasure… on bodily pain… on temperature… on food… on lodging, and on happiness, with consciousness not accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… produces an attainment, kills a living being… causes a split in the monastic community; faith not accompanied by happiness… lodging and happiness are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith not accompanied by happiness… for wisdom… for lust… for hatred… for longing… for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, for the path, for the attainment of fruition and for happiness. (1)
A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith not accompanied by happiness, with consciousness accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue not accompanied by happiness… on wisdom… on lust… on longing… on bodily pleasure… on bodily pain… on temperature… on food… on lodging, and on happiness, with consciousness accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… produces an attainment; with consciousness accompanied by happiness one takes what is not given; tells lies… speaks divisively… chatters idly… breaks into houses… carries off plunder… robs a single house… lies in ambush on the road… goes to another's wife… raids a village… raids a town; faith not accompanied by happiness… lodging and happiness are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith accompanied by happiness… for wisdom… for lust… for conceit… for wrong view… for longing… for bodily pleasure… for the path, for the attainment of fruition. (2)
A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness and a state not accompanied by happiness by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith not accompanied by happiness, with consciousness accompanied by happiness one gives a gift… (the same as the second course) fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue not accompanied by happiness… on lodging and on happiness, one gives a gift… produces an attainment, with consciousness accompanied by happiness one takes what is not given…; faith not accompanied by happiness… lodging and happiness are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for what is accompanied by happiness… for faith… for longing… for bodily pleasure, for the path, for the attainment of fruition and for happiness. (3)
A state accompanied by happiness and a state not accompanied by happiness are a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of strong-support condition… three. ^7-35-173

####### *The Pre-arising Condition and the Rest* ^7-4-1-1-217-4-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-174]]

A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state not accompanied by happiness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… the physical base, with consciousness not accompanied by happiness, as impermanent… one sees it with insight, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust not accompanied by happiness arises… distress arises, happiness arises; one sees a visible form with the divine eye… the tangible base for body-consciousness…. Pre-arising physical base – the eye base for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates not accompanied by happiness and for happiness. (1)
A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… the physical base, with consciousness accompanied by happiness, as impermanent… one sees it with insight, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust accompanied by happiness arises, wrong view arises. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates accompanied by happiness. (2)
A state not accompanied by happiness is a condition for a state accompanied by happiness and a state not accompanied by happiness by way of pre-arising condition – pre-arising object, pre-arising physical base. Pre-arising object – the eye… the physical base, with consciousness accompanied by happiness, as impermanent… one sees it with insight, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, happiness and the associated aggregates arise. Pre-arising physical base – the physical base is a condition, by way of pre-arising condition, for aggregates accompanied by happiness and for happiness. (3)
By way of post-arising condition… three… by way of repetition condition… nine. ^7-35-174

States accompanied by equanimity and states that are not accompanied by equanimity are a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by equanimity. (The base should be worked out.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for each following equanimity; death-consciousness accompanied by equanimity and equanimity for rebirth-consciousness not accompanied by equanimity… adverting and equanimity for the aggregates not accompanied by equanimity… the resultant mind element and equanimity for the resultant mind-consciousness element not accompanied by equanimity… life-continuum accompanied by equanimity and equanimity for life-continuum not accompanied by equanimity… the wholesome and unwholesome accompanied by equanimity and equanimity for emergence not accompanied by equanimity… the functional and equanimity for emergence… fruit and equanimity for emergence… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception and equanimity are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the attainment of fruition not accompanied by equanimity. (The base should be worked out.) Preceding aggregates accompanied by equanimity and equanimity are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates accompanied by equanimity and for equanimity. (3)
By way of contiguity condition… by way of co-arising condition… nine… by way of mutuality condition… nine… by way of support condition… nine. ^7-35-189

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-4-1-1-239-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-190]]

A state accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of strong-support condition… three.
A state that is not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state that is not accompanied by equanimity by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith not accompanied by equanimity, with consciousness not accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift, the precepts… the observance-day duties… jhāna not accompanied by equanimity… insight… the path… one produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue not accompanied by equanimity… wisdom… lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging and equanimity, with consciousness not accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift… produces an attainment, kills a living being… splits the monastic community; faith not accompanied by equanimity… lodging and equanimity are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith not accompanied by equanimity… for wisdom… for lust… for longing… for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain… for the path, for the attainment of fruition and for equanimity. (1)
A state that is not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of strong-support condition (all three kinds of strong-support). Relying on faith not accompanied by equanimity, with consciousness accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue not accompanied by equanimity… lodging and equanimity, with consciousness accompanied by equanimity one gives a gift… produces an attainment, takes what is not given, tells lies, speaks divisively… chatters idly… breaks into houses… carries off plunder… robs a single house… lies in ambush on the road… goes to another's wife… raids a village… raids a town; faith not accompanied by equanimity… lodging and equanimity are a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith accompanied by equanimity… for longing… for the path, for the attainment of fruition.
A state that is not accompanied by equanimity is a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity and a state that is not accompanied by equanimity by way of strong-support condition (three kinds of strong-support, the same as the second pass). (3)
States accompanied by equanimity and states that are not accompanied by equanimity are a condition for a state accompanied by equanimity by way of strong-support condition… three. ^7-35-190

Natural strong-support – relying on faith of the sense sphere, one gives a gift… the precepts… the observance-day duties… produces insight, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue of the sense sphere… wisdom… lust… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, one gives a gift… produces insight, kills a living being… splits the monastic community; faith of the sense sphere… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith of the sense sphere… for longing… for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain. (1)

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-214]]

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-4-1-1-293-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-246]]

A state of the fine-material sphere is a condition for a state of the fine-material sphere by way of object condition – by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness of the fine-material sphere; aggregates of the fine-material sphere are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and knowledge of the future. A state of the fine-material sphere is a condition for a state not of the fine-material sphere by way of object condition – one reviews the first jhāna… reviews the fourth jhāna, reviews the divine eye, reviews the divine ear element… knowledge of supernormal powers… knowledge of others' minds… knowledge of recollecting past lives… knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma… reviews knowledge of the future; the aggregates of the fine-material sphere as impermanent… distress arises. (2) ^7-35-246

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-247]]

(1)
A state not of the fine-material sphere is a condition for a state of the fine-material sphere by way of object condition – one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element, by knowledge of others' minds knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not of the fine-material sphere; aggregates not of the fine-material sphere are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma and knowledge of the future. (2) ^7-35-247

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-4-1-1-293-3-0

Object-predominance – one reviews the first jhāna, giving it weight, enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises… the fourth jhāna… the divine eye… the divine ear element… knowledge of supernormal powers… knowledge of others' minds… knowledge of recollecting past lives… knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma… knowledge of the future, giving it weight, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises; giving the aggregates of the fine-material sphere weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance of the fine-material sphere is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. A state of the fine-material sphere is a condition for a state of the fine-material sphere and a state not of the fine-material sphere by way of predominance condition. ####### *The Root Condition* ^7-4-1-1-322-1-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-279]]

A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state of the immaterial sphere by way of root condition – roots of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth…. (The base should be worked out.) Roots of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of root condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (The base should be worked out.) Roots of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3)
A state not of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of root condition – roots not of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of root condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness; at the moment of rebirth…. (1) ^7-35-279

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-4-1-1-322-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-280]]

A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state of the immaterial sphere by way of object condition – the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of infinite consciousness; the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of object condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of object condition – one reviews the base of infinite space, the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness… reviews the base of neither perception nor non-perception; the aggregates of the immaterial sphere as impermanent… distress arises; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness of the immaterial sphere; aggregates of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, knowledge of the future and adverting. (2)
A state not of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of object condition – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust… distress arises; good deeds done in the past… from jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review fruit, review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, cleansing, the path, fruit and adverting; noble ones review abandoned defilements, suppressed defilements… previously… the eye… the physical base, the aggregates not of the immaterial sphere as impermanent… distress arises, one sees a visible form with the divine eye, hears a sound with the divine ear element, by knowledge of others' minds knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not of the immaterial sphere; the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… aggregates not of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, knowledge of others' minds, knowledge of recollecting past lives, knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma knowledge of the future and adverting. (1) ^7-35-280

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-4-1-1-322-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-281]]

A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state of the immaterial sphere by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance of the immaterial sphere is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – one reviews the base of infinite space, giving it weight… reviews the base of neither perception nor non-perception, giving it weight; giving the aggregates of the immaterial sphere weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance of the immaterial sphere is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (The base should be worked out.) Predominance of the immaterial sphere is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-35-281

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-282]]

A state not of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – giving… virtue… having carried out the observance-day duties, giving it weight, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; giving it weight, lust arises, wrong view arises; good deeds done in the past… from jhāna… noble ones, having emerged from the path, giving the path weight, review it; fruit… giving nibbāna weight, they review it; nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, cleansing, the path and fruit; the eye… giving the physical base and the aggregates not of the immaterial sphere weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving them weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance not of the immaterial sphere is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and matter produced by consciousness. (1) ^7-35-282

A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state of the immaterial sphere by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates of the immaterial sphere. A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of proximity condition – death-consciousness of the immaterial sphere for rebirth-consciousness not of the immaterial sphere, life-continuum of the immaterial sphere for adverting, aggregates of the immaterial sphere for emergence not of the immaterial sphere, and, for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception for the attainment of fruition are a condition, by way of proximity condition. (2) ^7-35-283

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-284]]

A state not of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of proximity condition – preceding aggregates not of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for following aggregates not of the immaterial sphere; conformity for change-of-lineage… conformity is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the attainment of fruition. A state not of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state of the immaterial sphere by way of proximity condition – death-consciousness not of the immaterial sphere is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for rebirth-consciousness of the immaterial sphere; aggregates not of the immaterial sphere are a condition, by way of proximity condition, for emergence of the immaterial sphere; the preliminary work for the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the base of infinite space; for the base of infinite consciousness… for the base of nothingness… the preliminary work for the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. (2)
By way of contiguity condition… by way of co-arising condition… five… by way of mutuality condition… two… by way of support condition… seven. ^7-35-284

####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-4-1-1-322-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-285]]

Natural strong-support – the base of infinite space is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of infinite consciousness; the base of infinite consciousness for the base of nothingness… the base of nothingness is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the base of neither perception nor non-perception. A state of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith of the immaterial sphere, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts… carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna not of the immaterial sphere, insight… the path… higher knowledge… produces an attainment, fosters conceit, adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue of the immaterial sphere… wisdom, one gives a gift… produces an attainment… fosters conceit… adopts a wrong view; faith of the immaterial sphere… wisdom of the immaterial sphere is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith not of the immaterial sphere… wisdom… lust… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… the path, the attainment of fruition. (2) ^7-35-285

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-286]]

A state not of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state not of the immaterial sphere by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on faith not of the immaterial sphere, one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts… carries out the observance-day duties, produces jhāna not of the immaterial sphere, insight… the path… higher knowledge… produces an attainment, fosters conceit… adopts a wrong view; relying on virtue not of the immaterial sphere… wisdom… lust… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… temperature… food… lodging, one gives a gift… produces an attainment… kills a living being… splits the monastic community; faith not of the immaterial sphere… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for faith not of the immaterial sphere… longing… bodily pleasure… bodily pain, the path, the attainment of fruition. A state not of the immaterial sphere is a condition for a state of the immaterial sphere by way of strong-support condition – proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. ####### *The Object Condition* ^7-4-1-1-349-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-314]]

A state leading out is a condition for a state not leading out by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness leading out; aggregates leading out are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
A state not leading out is a condition for a state not leading out by way of object condition – having given a gift… having undertaken the precepts… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust arises… distress arises; good deeds done in the past… having emerged from jhāna… noble ones review fruit, they review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for fruit and for adverting; noble ones review the defilements that have been abandoned… that have been suppressed… that they habitually indulged in before… the eye… the physical base, one sees the aggregates not leading out as impermanent… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees a visible form, with the divine ear element one hears a sound, by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness not leading out; the base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… the base of nothingness for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the visible-form base for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… aggregates not leading out are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of supernormal powers, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting.
A state not leading out is a condition for a state leading out by way of object condition – nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path. (2) ^7-35-314

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-4-1-1-349-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-315]]

A state leading out is a condition for a state leading out by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance leading out is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. A state leading out is a condition for a state not leading out by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, giving it weight. Co-arising predominance – predominance leading out is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. (The base to be worked out.) Predominance leading out is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-35-315

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-316]]

A state not leading out is a condition for a state not leading out by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – having given a gift… having undertaken the precepts… having carried out the observance-day duties, one reviews it, giving it weight, enjoys and delights in it; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises; good deeds done in the past… having emerged from jhāna…; noble ones review fruit, giving it weight, they review nibbāna, giving it weight; nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing and for fruit; the eye… the physical base, giving the aggregates not leading out weight, one enjoys and delights in them; giving that weight, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-arising predominance – predominance not leading out is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. A state not leading out is a condition for a state leading out by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the path. (2) ^7-35-316

A state leading out is a condition for a state leading out by way of strong-support condition. A state leading out is a condition for a state not leading out by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. A state not leading out is a condition for a state leading out by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. All five questions should be worked out. As in the Leading-Out Pair, so the Dependence Section, the Co-arising Section, the Condition Section, the Support Section, the Conjoined Section and the Association Section should be worked out, without difference; the items touched differ). ^7-35-329

####### *The Object Condition* ^7-4-1-1-358-2-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-331]]

A state fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of object condition – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, they review the defilements fixed that have been abandoned, the defilements they habitually indulged in before… they see the aggregates fixed as impermanent… with insight; by knowledge of others' minds one knows the consciousness of one who possesses consciousness fixed; aggregates fixed are a condition, by way of object condition, for knowledge of others' minds, for knowledge of recollecting past lives, for knowledge of how beings fare according to their kamma, for knowledge of the future and for adverting. (1)
A state not fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of object condition – after giving a gift, undertaking the precepts… carrying out the observance-day duties… good deeds done in the past… having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, enjoys and delights in it; with that as object, lust not fixed arises, wrong view… doubt… restlessness… distress not fixed arises; noble ones review fruit, they review nibbāna; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for change-of-lineage, for cleansing, for fruit and for adverting; noble ones review the defilements not fixed that have been abandoned, the defilements that have been suppressed… that they habitually indulged in before… the eye… the physical base, they see the aggregates not fixed as impermanent… with insight, they enjoy and delight in them; with that as object, lust not fixed… distress arises; with the divine eye one sees a visible form… is a condition, by way of object condition, for adverting. A state not fixed is a condition for a state fixed by way of object condition; nibbāna is a condition, by way of object condition, for the path; the material life faculty is a condition, by way of object condition, for the act of killing one's mother… the act of killing one's father… the act of killing an arahant… the act of drawing the Buddha's blood; for one who grasps at a physical base, aggregates fixed in wrongness arise; that physical base is a condition, by way of object condition, for the aggregates fixed in wrongness. (2) ^7-35-331

####### *The Predominance Condition* ^7-4-1-1-358-3-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-332]]

A state fixed is a condition for a state fixed by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates. A state fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Object-predominance – noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, giving it weight. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for matter produced by consciousness. A state fixed is a condition for a state fixed and a state not fixed by way of predominance condition. Co-arising predominance – predominance fixed is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. (3) ^7-35-332

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-333]]

A state not fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of predominance condition – object-predominance, co-arising predominance. Co-arising predominance – predominance not fixed is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the associated aggregates and for matter produced by consciousness. A state not fixed is a condition for a state fixed by way of predominance condition. Object-predominance – nibbāna is a condition, by way of predominance condition, for the path. (2) ^7-35-333

A state not fixed is a condition for a state fixed by way of proximity condition – distress not fixed for distress fixed, wrong view not fixed is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for fixed wrong view; change-of-lineage for the path… cleansing is a condition, by way of proximity condition, for the path. ####### *The Strong-Support Condition* ^7-4-1-1-358-5-0

![[1-SOURCES/Text/pi-7.md#^7-35-335]]

A state fixed is a condition for a state fixed by way of strong-support condition. Natural strong-support – the act of killing one's mother is a condition for the act of killing one's mother… for the act of killing one's father… for the act of killing an arahant… for the act of drawing the Buddha's blood… for the act of splitting the monastic community, and for fixed wrong view, by way of strong-support condition (the cycle). The first path is a condition for the second path… the third path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the fourth path. A state fixed is a condition for a state not fixed by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – having taken the life of one's mother… having split the monastic community, in order to counteract it one gives a gift, undertakes the precepts, carries out the observance-day duties; noble ones, relying on the path, produce an attainment that has not yet arisen, enter one that has arisen… the path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for skill in what is possible and what is impossible; the path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the attainment of fruition. (1)
A state not fixed is a condition for a state fixed by way of strong-support condition – object strong-support, proximity strong-support, natural strong-support…. Natural strong-support – relying on lust not fixed, one takes the life of one's mother… splits the monastic community; relying on hatred not fixed… lodging, one takes the life of one's mother… splits the monastic community; lust not fixed… hatred… lodging is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the act of killing one's mother… for the act of splitting the monastic community; the preliminary work for the first path is a condition for the first path… the preliminary work for the fourth path is a condition, by way of strong-support condition, for the fourth path.
